articles.articleText: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs. This is Part 5 in the technical article series about Bitcoin covenants by Cointelegraph Research. To read the previous article click here. MATT (Merkleize All The Things) is a smart contract framework for Bitcoin that enables stateful contracts and scalable fraud proofs. A stateful contract carries information forward across multiple transactions and can update this information as the contract evolves. Standard Bitcoin scripts do not provide this capability, because each transaction is evaluated independently with no memory of previous executions. Every covenant proposal allows state-carrying UTXOs to an extent, as illustrated by scripting languages such as Sapio, which builds on OP_CTV. This works by using addresses to represent a finite state automaton, where transactions function as the state transitions. However, there is no way to elegantly implement numerical logic in this paradigm, a gap filled by MATT, and in particular its proposed implementation through OP_CCV. Because MATT allows committed data to be computed at spend time and re-embedded into the next output, each spend can derive a new state dynamically, instead of choosing from a predetermined set of states. How OP_CCV commits state into a Taproot key To understand the MATT proposal, it is useful to first review how Taproot commits data through public keys. Every Taproot output contains a base public key, called the internal key, which can be cryptographically modified or “tweaked” to commit to extra information. Formally, the tweaked public key is Q = P + t·G, where P is the internal key, G is the generator of the secp256k1 elliptic curve, and t is a tagged hash of P and the committed data. In a regular Taproot output, this commitment typically encodes the Merkle root of a taptree, which contains hidden spending paths. MATT builds on this mechanism to also embed contract state into the key. Instead of embedding complex logic directly in Bitcoin’s scripting language, MATT encodes computation as a sequence of state commitments, and the chain verifies only that each state transition is valid. MATT can be realized through different opcode combinations. The most direct and well-specified implementation relies on OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY (OP_CCV). OP_CCV provides the primitive that makes state-carrying UTXOs feasible within Taproot. OP_CCV allows a script to verify that a Taproot input or output key has been tweaked to commit to a specific piece of state data. The internal key is first tweaked with a hash of the contract’s current state, and then Taproot’s standard taptree tweak is applied on top. The resulting output key therefore commits to both the tapscript (the set of spending conditions) and the current state of the contract. OP_CCV can then enforce what state is carried forward into the next output. It allows the script to inspect the state data provided on the witness stack, perform computations on it, and require that the resulting updated state is correctly re-committed in a specified output. This is how state transitions are enforced on-chain. The stack format is: OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY The opcode supports three modes for checking an output as well as a separate input mode. In default mode, the entire BTC value of the input UTXO is allocated to the specified output; in deduct mode, only a portion equal to the output’s amount is assigned, leaving the remainder available for further outputs; and in ignore mode, the script and data commitment are verified without constraining the amount. Because default and deduct modes are designed to preserve value across checked outputs, transaction fees must be paid through separate fee-paying inputs. A dedicated fee input and change output can be added to the transaction without conflicting with the covenant’s constraints. This prevents the accidental burning of funds that can occur in more primitive covenant implementations, such as OP_CTV or SIGHASH_ANYPREVOUT. It also addresses a major limitation of presigned-transaction-style covenants, which typically define amounts upfront and therefore cannot accommodate dynamic fee adjustments or partial unvaults. OP_CCV + OP_CAT: Merkle Proofs and Fraud Proofs When OP_CCV is combined with OP_CAT, the full MATT framework becomes even more expressive. OP_CAT enables byte concatenation in Script, which makes it possible to construct and verify Merkle proofs directly on-chain. Two distinct Merkle trees are associated with a Taproot output in such an arrangement. The first is the familiar Taproot script tree (the taptree), whose leaves are the contract’s spending scripts. The second is a separate state tree, whose leaves are the contract’s data, such as the intermediate steps of a computation. The OP_CCV + OP_CAT script can verify a Merkle proof against the current state tree root, compute the updated root after a transition, and use OP_CCV to force the next output to commit to it. This construction enables fraud-proof systems with a slashing condition in which a long computation is committed off-chain, and only the specific disputed step (with its path in the binary tree) needs to be revealed and verified on-chain. Similar systems exist as optimistic rollups on other blockchain systems: the full computation runs off-chain, and the on-chain contract only intervenes when someone raises a challenge. Fraud proofs require that the computation be compiled down to a binary circuit or equivalent step-by-step representation that can be committed to in a Merkle tree. OP_CCV + OP_CAT would avoid the need for the Lamport one-time signatures and pre-signed transaction graphs that BitVM relies on to enforce state consistency. Beyond fraud proofs, the OP_CCV and OP_CAT combination also has implications for vaults. OP_CCV alone can implement vaults, but when combined with OP_CAT, it allows fully featured vaults that are essentially equivalent to the functionality proposed by OP_VAULT. As James O’Beirne, the author of OP_VAULT, has noted, OP_CCV represents a more general and robust design that effectively supersedes his earlier proposal. In the next article in this series, we will move on from general covenant proposals to review application-specific opcodes such as OP_VAULT, OP_UNVAULT, and OP_EVICT. Each of the opcodes are designed to solve a specific problem rather than provide broad programmability. Magazine: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?

articles.titleTr: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
articles.summaryTr: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.
articles.articleText: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion. CoreWeave shares jumped 15.27% in premarket trading Wednesday after the AI cloud provider reported third-quarter revenue that beat analyst estimates. The shares traded at $56.12 as of 12:50 pm UTC, trimming the stock’s year-to-date decline to 32%, according to Yahoo Finance. CoreWeave reported $3.66 billion in third-quarter revenue after the market closed on Tuesday, up 168% from $1.36 billion a year earlier. Revenue came in about 3.4% above the $3.54 billion consensus estimate compiled by Google Finance. The company also reported a revenue backlog of about $132.5 billion as of Sept. 30. The figure includes revenue CoreWeave expects to recognize under existing customer contracts, subject to delivery and service availability. In April, CoreWeave announced a multiyear agreement with AI developer Anthropic to provide computing capacity for its Claude models. Days later, CoreWeave signed a $6 billion deal with quantitative trading company Jane Street to supply cloud infrastructure for trading and research. CoreWeave started as a crypto miner and began shifting to AI infrastructure in 2019. Related: CoreWeave shows how crypto-era infrastructure quietly became AI’s backbone

articles.title: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
articles.summary: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
articles.summaryTr: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.
articles.articleText: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators. The Financial Stability Board (FSB) urged Turkey to tighten its oversight of crypto markets and adopt dedicated rules for stablecoins. In a peer review published on Wednesday, the global financial watchdog said Turkish authorities had made progress by introducing registration and licensing requirements for crypto service providers. The report was part of the FSB’s regular program of country reviews and assessed Turkey’s progress in implementing the board’s 2023 global recommendations on crypto and stablecoins. It followed a broader 2025 review that found gaps in how jurisdictions had implemented those recommendations. The FSB recommended that Turkey begin monitoring crypto-related risks to financial stability under a formal framework, strengthen supervision and enforcement, and improve cooperation and information sharing with foreign regulators. Turkey’s Capital Markets Board introduced licensing and operational requirements for crypto exchanges and custodians in March 2025, including minimum capital thresholds. The FSB said Turkey had introduced safeguards including requirements to segregate assets held in custody and a ban on domestic crypto payments. The safeguards help limit the spread of crypto-related risks to banks and payment systems. Authorities also launched a centralized platform to monitor crypto activities. The FSB’s 2025 review found that Turkey had finalized rules for crypto assets but lacked a dedicated stablecoin framework. In June 2025, Turkey’s Finance Ministry outlined plans to introduce additional transaction checks and limits on stablecoin transfers to combat money laundering. Related: Turkey tightens crypto rules with source, purpose checks on transfers

articles.articleText: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives. Zcash (ZEC) fell to a two-month low of $962.85 on Wednesday, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to nonprofits and projects supporting the Zcash network. As of 12:20 pm UTC Wednesday, Zcash’s 13.5% drop led 24-hour losses among the 100 largest cryptocurrencies by market capitalization and was down 24.5% over seven days. The decline was part of a broader crypto sell-off that left Bitcoin (BTC) down 5.8% and Ether (ETH) down 11.6% over the same period, according to CoinGecko. Crypto prices fell further Tuesday after US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October from the previous month, above economists’ 0.3% forecast. Zcash lets users send shielded payments that keep sender and recipient addresses and transaction amounts out of public view. Zcash helped drive this year’s rally in privacy coins, gaining 138% in the 30 days to Sept. 7. It remains the largest privacy coin by market value, accounting for about 60% of the $28 billion category tracked by CoinGecko. The category’s combined market value fell about 7% over 24 hours. ZEC traded above $1,370 as recently as Friday, when Zcash activated its NU7 upgrade. The upgrade cut the target time between blocks from 75 seconds to 25 to speed up transaction confirmations. It also made about 12,224 ZEC held in the network’s original privacy pool unspendable. Grayscale converted its Zcash Trust into a US spot exchange-traded fund (ETF) that began trading on NYSE Arca on Aug. 25. The fund recorded about $15 million in net outflows in November through Monday, following about $46 million in October, according to SoSoValue. Related: Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade

articles.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
articles.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements
articles.articleText: Release Number 9322-26 CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission’s Division of Clearing and Risk today issued a no-action letter addressing whether derivatives clearing organizations may use trust companies to conduct daily settlements with clearing members. According to the letter, a derivatives clearing organization may use a trust company for daily settlements if it treats the trust company as it would a settlement bank under applicable CFTC requirements. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

articles.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

news.articleText: Apple hisselerinde rekor rallisi! Yükseliş yüzde 30'a ulaşırken piyasalar hareketlendi - Apple hisseleri, 2026 başından bu yana yüzde 30 yükselerek tüm zamanların rekorunu kırdı. Çarşamba günü yaklaşık 900 bin opsiyon işlemi gerçekleşirken alım opsiyonlarının hacmi satım opsiyonlarını geride bıraktı. Apple hisseleri, teknoloji piyasasındaki sert satışlara ve faiz artışı endişelerine rağmen yükselişini sürdürerek tüm zamanların en yüksek seviyesine ulaştı. 2026 başından bu yana yüzde 30 değer kazanan hissede, opsiyon işlemlerinde de alım yönlü hareketlilik dikkat çekti. Apple hisselerinde rekor yükseliş CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle CNBC sunucusu Jim Cramer'ın sıkça dile getirdiği "Apple'a yatırım yaparsınız, al-sat yapmazsınız" yaklaşımı, şirket hisselerinin son performansıyla yeniden gündeme geldi. Apple hisseleri çarşamba günü yüzde 1,79 yükselerek 354,75 dolara ulaştı. Şirketin hisseleri, kısa süreli bilanço kaynaklı düşüşe rağmen geçen hafta Covid-19'dan bu yana teknoloji hisselerinde görülen en sert satış dalgasını, yarı iletken sektöründeki ayı piyasasını ve faiz artışı endişelerini geride bıraktı. Böylece Apple'ın 2026 yılındaki toplam yükselişi yüzde 30'a ulaştı ve hisse yeni bir rekor seviyeye çıktı. Opsiyon piyasasında alım yönlü hareketlilik Apple hisselerindeki dirençli görünüm, teknoloji sektöründe güvenli liman arayan opsiyon yatırımcılarının da dikkatini çekti. Çarşamba günü seansın ilk yarısında Apple hisseleri üzerinde yaklaşık 900 bin opsiyon işlemi gerçekleştirildi. Bunların yaklaşık 500 bini alım (call), 370 bini ise satım (put) opsiyonlarından oluştu. Yatırımcılar ayın başında şirketin bilançosu öncesinde satım opsiyonlarına yönelmişti. Ancak hisselerin yeniden yükselişe geçmesiyle put/call açık pozisyon oranı 0,95'ten 0,87'ye geriledi. Günlük işlem hacminde ise alım opsiyonları öne çıktı. Bu tablo, Apple hisselerindeki yükselişin opsiyon piyasasında da alım yönlü beklentileri güçlendirdiğine işaret ediyor.

news.titleTr: ABD medyası yazdı: Avrupa'nın yeni kuralları Türk beyaz eşya devine yarayabilir
news.summaryTr: AB'nin Çin'den ithalata yönelik kuralları sıkılaştırma ve yerel üretimi destekleme adımları Arçelik'e avantaj sağlayabilir. Bloomberg'e göre şirket, Avrupa'daki fabrikaları sayesinde Çinli rakiplerine karşı daha güçlü konumda olmayı hedefliyor.
news.articleText: ABD medyası yazdı: Avrupa'nın yeni kuralları Türk beyaz eşya devine yarayabilir - AB'nin Çin'den ithalata yönelik kuralları sıkılaştırma ve yerel üretimi destekleme adımları Arçelik'e avantaj sağlayabilir. Bloomberg'e göre şirket, Avrupa'daki fabrikaları sayesinde Çinli rakiplerine karşı daha güçlü konumda olmayı hedefliyor. Avrupa Birliği'nin ithalatı sıkılaştırma ve yerel üretimi destekleme adımları, Türk ihracatçılar arasında endişe yaratırken Arçelik için fırsata dönüşebilir. Bloomberg'in haberine göre şirket, Avrupa'daki mevcut fabrikaları sayesinde Çinli rakiplerine karşı avantaj elde edebileceğini düşünüyor. Avrupa'daki fabrikalar Arçelik'in elini güçlendiriyor CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Arçelik'in küresel markası Beko'nun Finans Direktörü Barış Alparslan, Türkiye'deki rekabetçi üretim yapısı ve Avrupa'daki fabrikaların şirkete önemli avantaj sağladığını belirtti. Beko'nun Avrupa'da halihazırda üretim tesislerine sahip olması, şirketin yerel üretimi desteklemeyi amaçlayan yeni AB düzenlemelerine Çinli rakiplerinden daha kolay uyum sağlamasına imkan tanıyabilir. Alparslan, Beko'nun Avrupa'daki güçlü marka bilinirliğinin de rekabette önemli rol oynadığını ifade etti. Bu konumun şirketin fiyatlarını ve satış sonrası hizmetlerini koruyarak Çinli üreticilerle rekabet etmesine yardımcı olabileceği değerlendiriliyor. AB'nin yeni düzenlemeleri Türk ihracatçıları endişelendiriyor Avrupa Birliği, Çin'den yapılan ithalata bağımlılığı azaltmak ve Avrupa'daki üretimi güçlendirmek amacıyla yeni düzenlemeler üzerinde çalışıyor. Bu kapsamda, belirli ithal ürünlerin üretiminden kaynaklanan karbon emisyonlarını fiyatlandıran Sınırda Karbon Düzenleme Mekanizması (SKDM) ve Avrupa'da üretilen ürünleri desteklemeyi hedefleyen "Made in Europe" girişimi öne çıkıyor. Avrupa, Türkiye'nin en önemli ihracat pazarlarından biri olduğu için söz konusu düzenlemeler Türk üreticiler açısından pazara erişim ve rekabet koşullarına ilişkin soru işaretleri yaratıyor. Arçelik ise Avrupa'daki mevcut üretim tesisleri sayesinde yeni dönemde Çinli rakiplerinden ayrışabileceğini düşünüyor. Arçelik'in üçüncü çeyrek zararı iki katı aştı Şirket, Avrupa pazarındaki rekabetin yanı sıra Türkiye'deki yüksek faiz oranları ve zayıf tüketici talebinin baskısıyla karşı karşıya. Arçelik, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 6,21 milyar TL net zarar açıkladı. Şirketin net zararı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 2,67 milyar TL'ye kıyasla iki katından fazla arttı. Arçelik'in Beko dışında Whirlpool ve Grundig markaları da bulunuyor.

news.title: Poundland set for more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
news.summary: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Poundland set for more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
news.summaryTr: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.
news.articleText: Poundland set for more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue - Published Poundland and its 11,000 employees are hopeful that the retailer's impending collapse can be delayed to allow time for a last-minute rescue deal. The discount chain has been edging towards administration after being blocked by its owners from accessing cash in its bank accounts. A deadline to secure a buyer for the business is set to expire at midnight, but sources close to the situation have told the BBC that they expect more time will be given, thanks to the release of £10m in funding. A committee of MPs questioned Gordon Brothers, Poundland's US owners, on Wednesday following accusations that the investment firm hopes to profit from selling off Poundland's 600 stores and stock piecemeal. Gordon Brothers - which bought the chain for just £1 last year - is accused of forcing that outcome by restricting Poundland's access to available cash needed to restock stores and pay wages and rent, ahead of the crucial Christmas trading period. The investment firm has denied the claims. But pressure remains on Poundland's owners after a takeover bid was rejected. The decision prompted calls for answers from politicians, including Prime Minister Andy Burnham. About £50m had been frozen by Gordon Brothers, the BBC understands, meaning Poundland bosses were unable to restock shelves across its 600 shops. However, sources close to the matter told the BBC on Tuesday that a release of £10m by its owners, while "small in the scale of things" could help at least postpone the chain's collapse while a longer term solution was explored. 'Do the right thing' Following the behind-closed-doors meeting between MPs on the business and trade committee and representatives of Gordon Brothers, chair Liam Byrne said he was "deeply concerned" that firm's behaviour "may have jeopardised thousands of jobs on Britain's high streets". "Over the last 17 months, they have taken millions out of Poundland when the business was on a 'knife edge'," he posted on social media., external "Now Poundland appears to be on the rebound, there's concerning signs it's been strangled of access to its own funds in what should be its busiest trading period in the run up to Christmas." He claimed that Gordon Brothers refused to say it would prioritise saving jobs "over and above its own financial returns", but added the prospect of a good outcome for the business was "now higher thanks to the focus on the business of the last week". He called on Gordon Brothers "to do the right thing" and give Poundland access to its own funds and work to protect the maximum number of jobs. Views on Poundland performance differ The 10-day moratorium to protect Poundland from its creditors expires on Thursday, but if there is a prospect of a solvent deal, the deadline could be extended. Views on the chain's performance differ between those running operations and the owners. Poundland boss Barry Williams told staff last week that like-for-like sales, which exclude new store openings, were up 11.4%. The sales period included Halloween, but Williams said this was £1.5m ahead of budget. He added the business made a profit of £18.1m in the year to September, which was a "strong recovery" from the previous year where there were losses of £68m. However, Gordon Brothers has painted a different picture, saying the chain remains "challenged and vulnerable to any potential downturn in future trading". There has been interest from the likes of Poundstretcher, Tesco and B&M in picking up Poundland stores which could mean continuing employment for workers in the event the chain is broken up and sold off in chunks. The main issue is whether a piecemeal sale would protect more jobs than a buyer willing to keep Poundland as a national chain. Get in touch Are you affected by issues discussed in this story? news.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
news.summary: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public. It is not known if the incidents are linked.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
news.summaryTr: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public. It is not known if the incidents are linked.
news.articleText: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax - Published Some 6,300 schools across Italy and more than 700 in Scotland and Northern Ireland have received bomb threats, according to local authorities. In Italy a number of buildings were evacuated as a precaution but Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said checks so far had not indicated any evidence of "concrete danger". "These reports appear rather linked to a strategy intended to cause alarm and concern," she said on Facebook. Scotland's education secretary Mairi McAllan said there was no risk to the public and specialist cyber-crime officers were working to identify the source of the messages. In Northern Ireland education officials told schools to remain open unless otherwise advised by police. It is unclear whether the incidents are connected. "As a parent and as a constituency MSP I understand just how concerning this will be for parents, for pupils, for carers and for school staff," McAllan said. Scottish police had earlier said that the warnings were "immediately assessed" as hoaxes. However some local authorities confirmed that some schools had been evacuated. "Our advice is that there is no requirement to evacuate schools or keep children away from education based solely on the content of the emails," Police Scotland said. Italian officials said a single email appeared to have been sent on Wednesday to the inboxes of 6,300 out of a total of 7,476 state schools, and private schools were unaffected. The message, said to be from a certain "Mikhail Andropov, leader of Vilayat di Misoginistan", caused alarm in many schools. The BBC has seen the email sent to Scottish schools which appeared to have similar wording, and also referenced the name Mikhail Andropov, although as leader of a "Red Owl" project. Italy's Education Minister Giuseppe Valditara said the incidents involving Italian schools were probably a "cyber-attack, not a genuine risk", adding that there appeared to be a clear strategy behind the rash of threats in across Europe targeting flights, supermarkets and even hospitals. Italian airports along with airlines elsewhere in Europe were hit by a series of bomb hoaxes last week that prompted a series of scares, evacuations and widespread disruption. Although a number of threats were claimed by an extremist misogynistic group, it later denied any link to the false warnings. - No risk to public from hoax school bomb threats, says government minister - Published45 minutes ago - Police treating threatening email sent to more than 300 schools as 'hoax' - Published3 hours ago On Wednesday one Milan headteacher, Anna Bertato, told Italian media she had checked the email address of the sender online: "It was already classified as spam by a student at a university in Taiwan." Another Milan headteacher, Massimo Nunzio Barrella, told Adnkronos news agency that he had immediately realised the email was spam when it arrived in his inbox at 08:59 and he decided not to evacuate his school and reassured parents who phoned in. "The text seemed almost comical," said Barrella, "it was like a message from Martians: 'We have come to annihilate you.' I even had a bit of a laugh." Although many schools were initially evacuated on Wednesday, the alarm was quickly lifted, and pupils were allowed to return to class. Some parents decided to take their children home for the day, but the majority of schools in Milan did not send their pupils home. Some 280 school head teachers had already received threats in recent days, according to Italian reports. In a statement, the head of the central Umbria region Stefania Proietti said "checks conducted so far in Umbrian schools have proved negative, and law enforcement is working rapidly and carefully to verify each report". news.summaryTr: ABD borsalarında sert düşüşlerin ardından yatırımcıların stratejileri değişti. Bank of America verilerine göre, kurumsal yatırımcılar 6,1 milyar dolarlık alım yaparken bireysel yatırımcılar yaklaşık 2 milyar dolarlık satış gerçekleştirdi.
news.articleText: ABD borsasında roller değişti: Büyükler alıyor, küçükler satıyor - ABD borsalarında sert düşüşlerin ardından yatırımcıların stratejileri değişti. Bank of America verilerine göre, kurumsal yatırımcılar 6,1 milyar dolarlık alım yaparken bireysel yatırımcılar yaklaşık 2 milyar dolarlık satış gerçekleştirdi. ABD hisse senedi piyasalarında artan oynaklık, büyük yatırımcılarla bireysel yatırımcıların farklı yönlere hareket etmesine neden oldu. Bank of America'nın (BofA) yayımladığı verilere göre, son satış dalgasını fırsat olarak değerlendiren kurumsal yatırımcılar güçlü alımlara yönelirken bireysel yatırımcılar piyasadan çıkışlarını sürdürdü. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Bankanın verileri, kurumsal müşterilerin geçen hafta 6,1 milyar dolardan fazla hisse senedi satın aldığını ortaya koydu. Bu alımların yaklaşık 4 milyar dolarlık bölümünü hisse senedi borsa yatırım fonları (ETF) oluşturdu. Buna karşılık bireysel yatırımcılar üst üste dördüncü haftada da net satıcı konumunda kaldı. BofA'nın bireysel müşterileri aynı dönemde yaklaşık 2 milyar dolarlık hisse senedi sattı. Borsada alışılmış strateji tersine döndü Piyasalardaki bu ayrışma, son dönemde yatırımcı davranışlarında yaşanan değişime işaret ediyor. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump'ın 2 Nisan 2025'te açıkladığı ve "Kurtuluş Günü" olarak adlandırdığı tarife kararlarından bu yana bireysel yatırımcılar, piyasalardaki sert düşüşleri alım fırsatı olarak değerlendiriyordu. Ancak son satış dalgasında bu eğilim tersine döndü. Demokratların ABD ara seçimlerinde Kongre'nin her iki kanadında da kontrolü ele geçirmesiyle artan siyasi belirsizlik ve yapay zeka şirketlerinin büyüme beklentilerine ilişkin endişeler, piyasalardaki dalgalanmayı artırdı. Özellikle son yıllarda ABD borsalarındaki yükselişe öncülük eden teknoloji ve yapay zeka hisselerinde yaşanan satışlar, yatırımcıların risk iştahını olumsuz etkiledi. Bireysel yatırımcılar piyasaya destek vermeyi bıraktı RBC Capital Markets Türev Stratejisi Başkanı Amy Wu Silverman, CNBC'ye yaptığı değerlendirmede bireysel yatırımcıların geçmişte piyasa düşüşlerinde dengeleyici rol üstlendiğini ancak bu durumun değiştiğini söyledi. Silverman, bireysel yatırımcıların daha önce düşüşlerde alım yaparak geniş piyasa için destek oluşturduğunu, son dönemde ise bu desteğin ortadan kalkmasının ötesinde ters yönde bir hareket yaşandığını belirtti. Özellikle opsiyon piyasasında bireysel yatırımcıların artan tedirginliğinin fiyat hareketlerini hızlandırdığını ifade eden Silverman, bu davranışın piyasanın diğer bölümlerinde de zincirleme etki yarattığını kaydetti. Gözler kurumsal yatırımcıların hamlelerinde Yapay zeka bağlantılı hisselerdeki satışların etkisiyle S&P 500 endeksi geçen perşembe günü yüzde 4 gerilerken Nasdaq Bileşik Endeksi düzeltme bölgesine girdi. Endeksler daha sonra kayıplarının bir bölümünü telafi etse de piyasalardaki belirsizlik devam ediyor. Wall Street'in korku göstergesi olarak bilinen Cboe Volatilite Endeksi (VIX), çarşamba günü 18 seviyesi civarında işlem gördü. Önümüzdeki dönemde kurumsal yatırımcıların alımlarını sürdürüp sürdürmeyeceği ve bireysel yatırımcıların yeniden piyasaya dönüp dönmeyeceği yakından izlenecek. İki yatırımcı grubu arasındaki ayrışmanın kalıcı hale gelmesi, ABD borsalarındaki fiyat hareketlerinin yönü açısından belirleyici olabilir.

news.titleTr: Borsada 5 şirketten peş peşe temettü açıklaması: Kararlar belli oldu
news.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören 5 şirket, KAP üzerinden temettü kararlarını açıkladı. Şirketlerden biri kâr payı dağıtmama kararını kesinleştirirken, diğer 4 şirketin önerileri genel kurul onayına sunulacak. İşte o şirketler ve kararların gerekçeleri.
news.articleText: Borsada 5 şirketten peş peşe temettü açıklaması: Kararlar belli oldu Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören 5 şirket, KAP üzerinden temettü kararlarını açıkladı. Şirketlerden biri kâr payı dağıtmama kararını kesinleştirirken, diğer 4 şirketin önerileri genel kurul onayına sunulacak. İşte o şirketler ve kararların gerekçeleri. Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören şirketlerden temettü açıklamaları gelmeye devam ediyor. 11 Kasım Çarşamba günü Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) yapılan bildirimlerde Tuğçelik Alüminyum, Cosmos Yatırım Holding, Zedur Enerji, Albayrak Hazır Beton ve Casa Emtia'nın 2025 yılına ilişkin kâr dağıtım kararları ve önerileri duyuruldu. Beş şirketin de nakit veya bedelsiz pay şeklinde kâr payı dağıtımı öngörmediği açıklanırken, Cosmos Yatırım Holding'in kararı genel kurulda kabul edildi. Diğer dört şirketin temettü dağıtmama önerileri ise genel kurul onayına sunulacak. Tuğçelik Alüminyum ve Metal Mamülleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş., 2025 yılına ilişkin kâr payı dağıtımı yapılmaması yönündeki yönetim kurulu teklifini KAP'a bildirdi. Şirketin Türkiye Finansal RaporTuğçelik Alüminyum (TUCLK)lama Standartları'na (TFRS) göre hazırlanan finansal tablolarında 127 milyon TL net dönem zararı oluşurken, yasal kayıtlarda 22,8 milyon TL net dönem kârı hesaplandı. Yönetim kurulu, yasal yedekler ayrıldıktan sonra kalan tutarın geçmiş yıllar kâr ve zararları hesabına aktarılmasını ve temettü dağıtılmamasını önerdi. Karar, 2 Aralık 2026 tarihinde gerçekleştirilecek genel kurulun onayına sunulacak. Cosmos Yatırım Holding (COSMO) Cosmos Yatırım Holding, 2025 yılı kârının geçmiş yıllar zararları hesabına aktarılması yönündeki yönetim kurulu önerisinin 11 Kasım'da yapılan genel kurulda kabul edildiğini duyurdu. Şirketin SPK düzenlemelerine göre hazırlanan finansal tablolarında 7,29 milyon TL net dönem kârı bulunmasına rağmen, geçmiş yıllar zararları nedeniyle net dağıtılabilir dönem zararı 127,97 milyon TL olarak hesaplandı. Alınan karar doğrultusunda pay sahiplerine nakit veya bedelsiz temettü ödemesi yapılmayacak. Zedur Enerji (ZEDUR) Zedur Enerji Elektrik Üretim A.Ş., 2025 yılı hesap dönemine ilişkin kâr payı dağıtılmaması yönünde yönetim kurulu kararı aldığını açıkladı. Şirketin bağımsız denetimden geçmiş finansal tablolarında 20,73 milyon TL net dağıtılabilir dönem kârı hesaplanırken, Vergi Usul Kanunu kapsamında tutulan yasal kayıtlarda 70,22 milyon TL zarar oluştu. Yasal kayıtlarda dağıtılabilir kâr bulunmaması nedeniyle temettü ödenmemesi yönündeki teklif, 15 Aralık 2026 tarihinde yapılacak olağan genel kurulda pay sahiplerinin onayına sunulacak. Albayrak Hazır Beton (ALBTN) Albayrak Hazır Beton Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş., 2025 yılına ilişkin kâr payı dağıtmama önerisini KAP'a bildirdi. Şirketin TFRS'ye göre hazırlanan finansal tablolarında 14,99 milyon TL, yasal kayıtlarında ise 38,11 milyon TL net dönem kârı oluştu. Yönetim kurulu, işletme sermayesi ihtiyaçları, yatırım ve finansman gereksinimleri ile mali yapının güçlendirilmesi hedeflerini dikkate alarak kârın dağıtılmamasını önerdi. Bu kapsamda, yasal yedekler ayrıldıktan sonra TFRS'ye göre 13,09 milyon TL, yasal kayıtlara göre ise 36,21 milyon TL tutarındaki kârın şirket bünyesinde tutulması planlanıyor. Temettü dağıtılmaması yönündeki teklif, 4 Aralık 2026 tarihinde yapılacak genel kurulda görüşülecek. Casa Emtia (CASA) Casa Emtia Petrol Kimyevi ve Türevleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş., 2025 yılı finansal sonuçlarında zarar oluşması nedeniyle kâr payı dağıtılmaması yönünde karar aldığını duyurdu. Şirketin SPK düzenlemelerine göre hazırlanan finansal tablolarında 131,19 milyon TL, yasal kayıtlarında ise 97,02 milyon TL net dönem zararı oluştu. Yönetim kurulu, 2025 yılına ilişkin nakit veya bedelsiz temettü dağıtılmaması önerisinin olağan genel kurulda pay sahiplerinin onayına sunulacağını açıkladı. Temettü kararlarında genel kurul süreci 11 Kasım'da açıklama yapan beş şirketin tamamı 2025 yılına ilişkin kâr payı dağıtmamayı öngörüyor. Ancak şirketlerin gerekçeleri farklılık gösteriyor. Tuğçelik Alüminyum, Zedur Enerji ve Casa Emtia'nın açıklamalarında finansal tablolardaki zararlar veya yasal kayıtlarda dağıtılabilir kâr bulunmaması öne çıkarken, Albayrak Hazır Beton kârını yatırım ve finansman ihtiyaçları için şirket bünyesinde tutmayı planlıyor. Cosmos Yatırım Holding'de temettü dağıtılmaması kararı genel kurulda kesinleşirken, diğer şirketlerde nihai karar genel kurul toplantılarında verilecek.

news.title: Missing 11-month-old baby found buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
news.summary: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.

news.titleTr: Missing 11-month-old baby found buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
news.summaryTr: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.
news.articleText: Missing 11-month-old baby found buried alive in a crate in South Carolina - Published An 11-month-old baby has been rescued in South Carolina after officials say he was buried alive in a crate by his father. Koah Sharpe had been missing since Monday when he was taken by his father, Michael Comer, 25, according to the Lexington County Sheriff's Department. Comer was arrested on a burglary charge on Monday evening but his son was not with him. The baby was found on Tuesday "buried alive" and "clinging to life" not far from his father's house, Lexington County Sheriff Jay Koon said at a news conference. It is thought he had been there for 24 hours. The child is now in hospital receiving care, Koon said, adding he was hopeful he would make a full recovery. Police are still deciding what further charges to bring against the father. The search for baby Koah began on Monday after his father took him from his mother's house. Comer's mother was watching the child and had left her son alone with him briefly, Koon said, when he left abruptly with Koah. Comer was seen travelling to multiple locations without the baby and was later arrested in Lexington County without Koah. A search party of 100 police and fire department officials were then sent to search for the child, the sheriff said. He added that when they asked Comer where his son was, he "did not have much to say" about his whereabouts. Koon said that rescuers searched the woods near Comer's father's house and saw some "freshly disturbed dirt". As they began to dig, they heard a baby crying - something the sheriff described as "the most joyful sound you ever heard". "The race was on. Everybody was getting down there trying to get him out," Koon added. He said the crate was wrapped in a towel that probably provided enough air for Koah to survive for as long as he did, while the cold weather kept him from getting too hot. "The crate was, probably, I'm guessing about a two-foot [61cm] by two-foot dog crate. So, I think, once that crate hit the ground, he was probably up at least a foot from the top of that crate to the top of the ground," Koon explained. Of the parents relationship, the sheriff said there were "obviously some issues". Comer had previously pleaded guilty to domestic violence charges, court records show. Comer's mother, Patricia Comer, told NBC News that Koah's mother had full custody of him but allowed her to supervise while her son watched him. She said her son had watched the baby before unsupervised without any problems. "Honestly, I'm his mother, and I never expected this from him," Patricia Comer said.

Comer was seen travelling to multiple locations without the baby and was later arrested in Lexington County without Koah. A search party of 100 police and fire department officials were then sent to search for the child, the sheriff said. He added that when they asked Comer where his son was, he "did not have much to say" about his whereabouts. Koon said that rescuers searched the woods near Comer's father's house and saw some "freshly disturbed dirt". As they began to dig, they heard a baby crying - something the sheriff described as "the most joyful sound you ever heard". "The race was on. Everybody was getting down there trying to get him out," Koon added. He said the crate was wrapped in a towel that probably provided enough air for Koah to survive for as long as he did, while the cold weather kept him from getting too hot. "The crate was, probably, I'm guessing about a two-foot [61cm] by two-foot dog crate. So, I think, once that crate hit the ground, he was probably up at least a foot from the top of that crate to the top of the ground," Koon explained. Of the parents relationship, the sheriff said there were "obviously some issues". Comer had previously pleaded guilty to domestic violence charges, court records show. Comer's mother, Patricia Comer, told NBC News that Koah's mother had full custody of him but allowed her to supervise while her son watched him. She said her son had watched the baby before unsupervised without any problems. "Honestly, I'm his mother, and I never expected this from him," Patricia Comer said.

news.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
news.summary: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.

news.titleTr: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
news.summaryTr: Talks in Abu Dhabi centred around Europe's security framework, with US envoys due to meet Putin and Zelensky on Thursday.
news.articleText: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough - Published Trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the US aimed at ending the war in Ukraine have concluded after a second day. Although the American side said they saw "some openings", there was no hint of any breakthroughs to end the nearly five year-long war sparked by Russia's invasion. However, both Moscow and Kyiv confirmed that a large-scale prisoner of war exchange was in the works and could be carried out soon. Davyd Arakhamia from Ukraine's negotiating team said that this round of talks - the first since February - "was one of the hardest." "I believe the Russians came with very strict directives, so it was extremely difficult to soften the discussion," he said. But he added that he felt "good momentum" and urged for a second round of talks to be organised as soon as possible. Comments by Kremlin negotiator Vladimir Medinsky were less conciliatory. "Right now... a lot depends on Ukraine, on the position of the US, and on whether Europe comes to its senses," he said. After the talks it was announced that on Thursday US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner - President Donald Trump's son-in-law - would travel to Moscow to meet Russian President Vladimir Putin, and then to Dublin to speak to Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky. The meetings in Abu Dhabi had been framed as centred around the "security architecture" of Europe. For Kyiv, this may include reassurances that allies will come to its aid if Ukraine comes under attack again, despite the country not being a Nato member. For Moscow, a reworked "security framework" is likely to include a limit to the influence of Nato in eastern Europe - a central concern for the Kremlin since the alliance's eastward expansion. Earlier this week Kushner said the US hoped to "create a new framework" of security between Ukraine, Russia and Europe that could "secure lasting peace", while the Kremlin's Medinsky said the world needed a "new" and "fair" security system. That framework would serve as "a new Yalta and Potsdam", Medinsky said, referring to the 1940s summits in which the victorious Allied powers carved up post-war Europe into spheres of influence. Ukraine and Europe have long been concerned about the current US administration's commitment to European security and its softening towards the Kremlin. Representatives of Britain, Nato and various EU countries were also in Abu Dhabi and met with US and Ukrainian negotiators, but the Kremlin - with whom the EU does not officially communicate - said its delegation had not had any contact with them. Moscow has been dismissive of European involvement, although Europeans have long argued that they are central to any post-war dynamics on their continent. Many - particularly in eastern Europe - feel their security is linked to that of Ukraine. Agreements cannot be implemented "if no consensus can be reached among Nato members," a German government spokesperson said on Wednesday. Kushner said the US was keen to bring the Europeans on board and said that getting them "added to the format" would be on the agenda for his talks with Putin. There is also disagreement on whether discussions on a future security framework should be preceded by a ceasefire, as the Europeans and Kyiv would want, or whether the fighting only stops after an agreement has been reached, as the Kremlin has insisted. Any agreement on a peacetime security framework, however, is contingent on the war ending, Kushner noted. But that cannot occur "until there's an agreement on territory and on all other bilateral issues," he added. Since talks began last year, a core obstacle to any settlement has been Ukraine's eastern region of Donetsk, which is mostly occupied by Russia. Kyiv wants to freeze the contact line to maintain control over those areas, which it says are essential to its security. Moscow, meanwhile, has never backed down from its demand that Ukraine relinquish the parts of Donetsk it still holds. "Every inch" of land would be "returned to Russia one way or another", Medinsky said. Kushner acknowledged that the territorial question remained the hardest, while Zelensky's chief of staff and negotiator Kyrylo Budanov refused to be drawn on whether Russia was still demanding a Ukrainian withdrawal from the region. Later, Budanov admitted the talks had been "tough" and that Ukraine's priority was to ensure Russia could not attack it again. "These deals are very hard and complex, and this one is very emotional, very complex," Kushner said. "The reality is there is no trust right now between the sides and that is to be expected after a conflict like this." Related topics - Published1 day ago - Published22 hours ago

news.title: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
news.summary: Protests are also expected in the biggest cities less than three weeks before Spaniards vote in parliamentary elections.

news.titleTr: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years
news.summaryTr: Protests are also expected in the biggest cities less than three weeks before Spaniards vote in parliamentary elections.
news.articleText: Spain sees widespread disruption in first general strike for 14 years - Published Transport and other public services across Spain have faced serious disruption in the first general strike for 14 years called by the main unions over housing and the high cost of living. Demonstrations have taken place across the country, including in Madrid and Barcelona, where tens of thousands marched in the evening. Spaniards are due to vote in parliamentary elections on 29 November. The head of the big UGT labour union, Pepe Álvarez, said the strike was a success with "massive" participation, while Unai Sordo of the CC OO union said turnout was "very significant." However, the Spanish Confederation of Business Organisations said participation was "low and uneven", depending on the areas and sectors involved. Some of the biggest disruption on Wednesday was seen in the main industrial hubs of Madrid and the north-eastern region of Catalonia where traffic was halted on several main roads. The interior ministry said dozens of people were arrested for a variety of incidents and Spanish reports said estate agencies had seen attacks on their offices. The strike was triggered by widespread protests over affordable housing and rising living costs, after the eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal from a flat in Madrid where she had lived for seven decades. She died in hospital weeks later. Rental prices in the capital have soared in recent years. The monthly cost of a 50m sq apartment in Madrid was an average of €1,170 in October, according to property portal Idealista, while Spain's average gross monthly salary is about €2,460 (£2,056). That amounts to nearly half the average gross salary, well above the 30% level of affordability often recommended by housing experts and public institutions. Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez called snap elections last month after parliament failed to approve his plan for housing reform. Not since 2012, under the conservative government of Mariano Rajoy, has Spain held general strikes. And while previous strikes have been problematic for the government in power, this one is different. Sánchez and his ministers have even encouraged workers to down tools and demand affordable housing. "Your eight-hour day. Your pension. Your public healthcare… These were collective conquests," he wrote on social media, praising those who took part in previous strikes. Read more - Dramatic eviction of woman aged 87 highlights Spain's housing shortage - Published23 September - Spanish PM Sánchez calls early election after housing protests - Published5 October The conservative People's Party (PP), by contrast, has accused the government of attempting to weaponise the strike for electoral gain. PP leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo called the general strike "nonsense", calling the unions "mafia" and "trash". Feijoo's party is leading in the polls and party spokesman Miguel Tellado accused the government of exploiting the strike to warn voters against allowing a right-wing government to be formed, which looks the most likely outcome of the 29 November election. Sánchez told Spanish TV this week: "What is nonsense is to question the rights of workers to strike." Among those taking part in the general strike was Gonzalo Álvarez, 27, who was visiting different picket lines in central Madrid. Although he works in sales, he has been volunteering for a housing union that tries to protect tenants and makes them aware of their rights. The eviction of Maricarmen Abascal at the end of September "was the little fire" that sparked this protest, he told the BBC. Álvarez knew the 87-year-old, who had faced a tripling of her rent under new landlords, and says he was deeply upset by her treatment. He rents a small, one-bedroom flat with his girlfriend, a dental hygienist, in the city's southern Arganzuela disrict. The couple pay €1,000 between them, which means each spends about half of their salary on housing, even before other bills. "It's absolutely crazy… with the food, with the electricity, with the water, with gas." He sees no way of getting on the property ladder: "You have to collect an insane amount of money to be able to buy a house. So with these salaries, it's impossible." With current rent and purchase prices, he believes buying somewhere is "completely impossible". However, the vice-president of the CEOE, Spanish biggest business association, Miguel Garrido, criticised the strike, complaining that businesses had little to do with the price of housing. "This is not a strike for labour-related reasons, but rather for political ones, and it is closely linked to the early calling of elections," he said. Demonstrations were planned for some of Spain's biggest cities later in the day and the scale of support will be widely viewed as an indicator of public discontent ahead of the election. Another reliable indicator of support for strikes is the level of demand for electricity with Spain's industrial sector. Power usage in Spain fell by 7.5% during the early hours of Wednesday, according to data from operator Red Eléctrica. During the last general strike 14 years ago, equivalent consumption was down by more than 15%.

news.title: Satın alma onaylandı: Dev havayolu şirketi resmen satılıyor! Artık borsada olmayacaklar
news.summary: EasyJet hissedarları, ABD'li Apollo'nun 5,7 milyar sterlinlik satın alma teklifini onayladı. AB incelemesinin ardından işlemin 2027'nin ilk çeyreği bitmeden tamamlanması hedefleniyor. Satış gerçekleşirse easyJet Londra Borsası'ndan ayrılacak.

news.summaryTr: EasyJet hissedarları, ABD'li Apollo'nun 5,7 milyar sterlinlik satın alma teklifini onayladı. AB incelemesinin ardından işlemin 2027'nin ilk çeyreği bitmeden tamamlanması hedefleniyor. Satış gerçekleşirse easyJet Londra Borsası'ndan ayrılacak.
news.articleText: Satın alma onaylandı: Dev havayolu şirketi resmen satılıyor! Artık borsada olmayacaklar - EasyJet hissedarları, ABD'li Apollo'nun 5,7 milyar sterlinlik satın alma teklifini onayladı. AB incelemesinin ardından işlemin 2027'nin ilk çeyreği bitmeden tamamlanması hedefleniyor. Satış gerçekleşirse easyJet Londra Borsası'ndan ayrılacak. ABD merkezli özel sermaye şirketi Apollo'nun, İngiliz düşük maliyetli hava yolu easyJet'i 5,7 milyar sterlin karşılığında satın alma teklifi hissedarlar tarafından onaylandı. İşlemin gelecek yılın ilk çeyreği sona ermeden tamamlanması hedefleniyor. Hissedarların yüzde 97'sinden fazlası destekledi CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle EasyJet'in açıklamasına göre, oylamada temsil edilen hisselerin yüzde 97,07'si satın alma anlaşması lehine oy kullandı. Oy hakkına sahip hissedarların yüzde 83,29'u da teklifi destekledi. Böylece şirketin özel mülkiyete geçerek borsadan ayrılması için gereken hissedar onayı eşiği aşılmış oldu. AB incelemesi bekleniyor Hissedar onayının ardından satın alma işlemi, Avrupa Birliği'nin düzenleyici kuralları kapsamında incelemeye alınacak. EasyJet, işlemin gelecek yılın ilk çeyreği sona ermeden tamamlanmasını hedefliyor. Satışın tamamlanması halinde easyJet, 25 yılı aşkın süredir işlem gördüğü Londra Borsası'ndan ayrılacak. İşlem, Avrupa'da bir hava yolu şirketine yönelik en büyük özel sermaye satın almalarından biri olmaya hazırlanıyor.

Hareket Proje'nin 4,5 milyon dolarlık anlaşmaları, Orge Enerji'nin 276 milyon TL'lik sözleşmesi ve Türkiye Kalkınma Bankası'nın 250 milyon euroluk kredisi öne çıktı. Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören 6 şirket, 11 Kasım Çarşamba günü yeni sözleşme, iş ilişkisi, yatırım ve finansman gelişmelerini Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) bildirdi. Açıklamalarda milyonlarca dolarlık anlaşmalar, jeotermal enerji yatırımı ve 250 milyon avroluk kredi öne çıktı. Hareket Proje (HRKET): 4,5 milyon dolarlık iki ayrı anlaşma Hareket Proje Taşımacılığı ve Yük Mühendisliği, Kazakistan ve Birleşik Arap Emirlikleri'ndeki projeler kapsamında ağır nakliye ve vinç kiralama hizmetleri için 2,5 milyon dolarlık anlaşma imzaladı. Şirket ayrıca vagon taşımacılığı ve proje kargo taşımacılığı hizmetleri için iki ayrı sözleşme yaptı. Üç ay sürmesi planlanan bu projelerin toplam bedeli 2 milyon dolar olarak açıklandı. DCT Trading (DCTTR): 34,8 milyon TL'lik pamuk alım anlaşması DCT Trading, 2026-2027 sezonu yurt içi pamuk alımları kapsamında 34 milyon 775 bin TL tutarında anlaşma imzaladı. Emlak Konut GYO (EKGYO): 315 bağımsız bölüm için ruhsat alındı Emlak Konut GYO'nun İstanbul Esenler Oruçreis 2. Etap projesinde, Güzelbahçe Defne Evleri kapsamında 295 konut ve 20 ticari üniteden oluşan toplam 315 bağımsız bölüm için yapı ruhsatları alındı. Orge Enerji (ORGE): 276 milyon TL'lik veri merkezi sözleşmesi imzalandı Orge Enerji, Ankara'da inşası devam eden Veri Merkezi Projesi'nin ilk etap elektrik işlerine ilişkin sözleşme sürecini tamamladı. Şirketin 4 milyon 950 bin euro + KDV tutarındaki teklifi için işverenle sözleşme imzalandı. 23 Eylül 2026 tarihli TCMB kuru üzerinden yaklaşık 275 milyon 974 bin TL + KDV değerindeki işin 10 ayda tamamlanması planlanıyor. Kocaer Çelik (KCAER): İtalya merkezli şirketle jeotermal santral anlaşması Kocaer Çelik'in yüzde 99 iştiraki Kocaer Enerji, İtalya merkezli Exergy International ve Türkiye iştiraki Exergy Turkey ile santral tedarik sözleşmesi imzaladı. Sözleşme, Aydın'ın Buharkent ve Kuyucak ilçelerinde geliştirilen Kocaer-1 Jeotermal Enerji Santrali'nin ilk fazını kapsıyor. 12,34 MWe brüt kurulu güce sahip santral için ORC teknolojisine dayalı ekipmanların tasarımı, mühendisliği, imalatı ve tedariki gerçekleştirilecek. Türkiye Kalkınma ve Yatırım Bankası (KLNMA): KfW ile 250 milyon euroluk kredi Türkiye Kalkınma ve Yatırım Bankası, Alman Kalkınma Bankası KfW ile 250 milyon euro tutarında kredi anlaşması imzaladı.

news.title: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
news.summary: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says
news.summaryTr: The US Department of Justice says the men were involved in a string of plots, including a major incident near the UK airbase that is used by US armed forces.
news.articleText: Three Iran-backed suspects plotted attacks including RAF Fairford incident, US says - Published The US Department of Justice (DOJ) has announced charges against three Iran-backed operatives that it alleges were involved in a string of plots in the US and Europe. The DOJ said Iranian agents most recently "orchestrated a terrorist plot at an air force base in the United Kingdom", saying they were involved in the major incident in September near RAF Fairford in the UK, where US armed forces were stationed. The three men have been accused by the DOJ of being involved in 18 attacks and attempted attacks, including in London, Amsterdam and Paris. Some of the incidents were said to be directed by the men over FaceTime. The DOJ said they acted in the name of the group Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamiya (HAYI). Iranian Mohsen Mohajeri, Iraqi national Mohammad Ali al-Hassani and dual Iranian-Iraqi citizen Mohammad Baqer Saad Dawood al-Saadi were charged in an indictment unsealed on Tuesday, the DOJ said. The DOJ said that most recently, al-Hassani "orchestrated a terrorist plot" at RAF Fairford - where on 27 September a major incident was declared after suspicious vans were reported near the base. Seven men have been arrested in the UK over the incident at RAF Fairford. Iran has strongly denied any involvement. Al-Hassani and Mohajeri were allegedly both in Iran at the time of the incident, the indictment claims. Meanwhile, al-Saadi was coordinating with the pair through third parties from a prison in New York, where he is awaiting trial on previous charges after being arrested in August, it adds. US court records show that al-Saadi is due in court on 19 November, though it is not clear whether this status conference - which is usually a routine scheduled appearance - relates to the new charges or the previous ones. The BBC has asked the Southern District of New York for comment. Mohajeri and al-Hassani are not in custody, two sources told the BBC's US partner CBS News. The BBC has asked the DOJ for comment on the suspected whereabouts of the two men not in US custody. In the DOJ's statement detailing the indictments, it said: "Of the 18 terrorist attacks in the spring of 2026 for which HAYI claimed responsibility in Europe, seven took place in the UK." It added that the attacks involved "arsons, explosives, and in one instance, a near-fatal stabbing in London of two Jewish men, including a dual US-British citizen". Two Jewish men were stabbed in Golders Green, north London, in April. A suspect is due to stand trial next year. The indictment also details an arson attack on a Jewish charity in London on 17 April, which allegedly saw al-Hassani "directing" an individual over FaceTime. On 17 April , a building previously used by Jewish Futures, an educational charity, was set alight in Hendon, north-west London. The following day, the DOJ said al-Hassani participated in another video call with an individual carrying out an attack on a synagogue in London. On 18 April, Kenton United Synagogue in Harrow was targeted in an arson attack. A 17-year-old boy pleaded guilty to the incident earlier this year. The indictment also claims the three were involved in attacks on the Bank of New York Mellon building in Amsterdam on 15 March and on the Bank of America building in Paris on 28 March. It added that the trio tried to carry out attacks on "Jewish institutions in the US", including attempting to target a synagogue in Manhattan, New York in March or April. "This eight-count indictment shows the determination of Iran to commit terrorist attacks in Europe and the US," FBI Director Kash Patel said. He added that one of the three "allegedly sent coded messages to assist in future acts of violence" from detention. Patel said the accused were involved in nearly 20 attempted attacks in support of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and the Iran-backed Iraqi militia Kataib Hezbollah. RAF Fairford A major incident was declared on 27 September near the UK's RAF Fairford base, in the Cotswolds in Gloucestershire, after three suspicious vans were seen near the airbase. No explosive materials were found in the vans, but a quantity of petrol was seized. The DOJ said that in August, al-Hassani "allegedly directed and paid associates" in the UK to "conduct preparatory steps and arrange logistics for the RAF Fairford terrorist plot". On 22 August, al-Hassani paid one individual to "perform pre-operational surveillance of RAF Fairford's perimeter", the department said. In September, al-Hassani paid several people to help him prepare for the plot, the DOJ also alleged. According to its statement, this included "procuring vans and barrels of fuel, researching the purchase of chemical accelerants, including large quantities of potassium chloride, and purchasing metallic objects that could be used as explosive shrapnel". The suspects then gave the vans an appearance of being used by a fuel delivery business and a swimming pool supply business, the DOJ stated. "On 26 September, al-Hassani allegedly tasked individuals to drive three vans, some of which were later determined to contain barrels of fuel, to the RAF Fairford base." The DOJ also said al-Hassani was "in frequent communication" with the van drivers and helped to direct them where to drive. "At least two of the three vans, while en route to the perimeter of RAF Fairford, encountered a security roadblock and were not allowed to proceed on their intended route," it added. It was in the very early hours of 27 September, that the vans were spotted by a local farmer who was heading home from a party, and called the police. The Iranian embassy in London has said it "categorically rejects and strongly condemns" what it called "unfounded and malicious speculations" linking Iran to the incident. Two British nationals appeared in court last month in connection with the alleged Iran-linked plot. The US withdrew all its bombers from RAF Fairford after the incident, with President Donald Trump citing "some threats" to the base as the reason. RAF Fairford has been used by the US Air Force (USAF) for decades. In recent months, the US has flown B-1 and B-52 bombers from there to the Middle East for "defensive" strikes on Iran. In July, Iran said "any base used for aggression against Iranian territory constitutes a legitimate target for our forces".
