news.titleTr: Borsa İstanbul'da bir şirket TERA Fondaki hisselerini TMSF’den aldı
news.summaryTr: Blume Metal, tasfiye sürecindeki Tera Fon'da bulunan 497 bin 693 lot kendi hissesini TMSF'den pay başına 29,40 TL'ye satın aldı. İşlem sonrası şirketin elindeki payların sermayeye oranı yüzde 1,73'e yükseldi.
news.articleText: Borsa İstanbul'da bir şirket TERA Fondaki hisselerini TMSF’den aldı - Blume Metal, tasfiye sürecindeki Tera Fon'da bulunan 497 bin 693 lot kendi hissesini TMSF'den pay başına 29,40 TL'ye satın aldı. İşlem sonrası şirketin elindeki payların sermayeye oranı yüzde 1,73'e yükseldi. Blume Metal Kimya A.Ş. (BLUME), Tasfiye sürecindeki Tera Fon'da bulunan 497 bin 693 adet kendi payını Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonu'ndan (TMSF) satın aldı. İşlem, pay başına 29,40 TL kapanış fiyatı üzerinden gerçekleştirildi. 497 bin 693 lotluk hisse alımı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) yapılan açıklamaya göre TMSF, tasfiye sürecindeki Tera Fon'da bulunan 497 bin 693 lot BLUME payının öncelikle şirket tarafından satın alınmasını teklif etti. Blume Metal, yatırımcıları korumak ve ileriye dönük yatırım amacıyla söz konusu payları 11 Kasım 2026 tarihinde, 29,40 TL kapanış fiyatı üzerinden satın aldı. Şirketin elindeki payların oranı yüzde 1,73'e çıktı Açıklamada, işlemin pay geri alımı için ayrılan tutar dışındaki kaynaklardan karşılandığı belirtildi. Satın alma işleminin ardından Blume Metal'in sahip olduğu kendi paylarının nominal tutarı 3 milyon 33 bin 847 adede ulaştı. Bu payların şirket sermayesine oranı ise yüzde 1,73 olarak açıklandı.

Hisseler çakılmıştı, Morgan Stanley desteğini çekti - Nvidia hisseleri, Jensen Huang hakkındaki iddiaların ardından yaşanan iki günlük düşüşü çarşamba günü yüzde 3,95'lik yükselişle telafi etmeye çalıştı. Yatırımcılar, soruşturmanın şirketin faaliyetlerine ve 17 Kasım'daki bilançosuna etkisini izliyor. Nvidia hisseleri, CEO Jensen Huang hakkındaki iddiaların şirketin faaliyetlerine olası etkileri tartışılırken iki günlük düşüşün ardından çarşamba günü yükseldi. Yatırımcılar, skandalın şirketin işlerine ve yapay zekâ yatırımlarına yansıyıp yansımayacağını değerlendiriyor. İki günlük düşüşün ardından yüzde 3,95 yükseldi CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Nvidia hisseleri çarşamba günü yüzde 3 civarında yükselerek önceki iki işlem günündeki kayıpların ardından toparlandı. Hisse senedi pazartesi günü yüzde 4,3, salı günü ise yüzde 5,47 değer kaybetmişti. Düşüşte, Nvidia Üst Yöneticisi (CEO) Jensen Huang'ın Çin istihbaratıyla bağlantılı olduğu öne sürülen bir kişiyle ilişkisine dair iddiaların şirkete olası etkileri belirleyici oldu. Nvidia, salı günü şirket sırlarının veya ulusal güvenliğin tehlikeye girip girmediğini araştırmak üzere Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz hukuk bürosuyla anlaştığını duyurdu. Yatırımcılar üç olası senaryoyu değerlendiriyor Bank of America, salı günü yayımladığı değerlendirmede gelişmelerin Nvidia üzerindeki etkisine ilişkin üç senaryoya dikkat çekti. İlk senaryoda krizin sınırlı kalması ve şirket yönetiminde devamlılığın korunması öngörülüyor. İkinci senaryoda ise belirsizliğin uzaması ve bilanço öncesinde şirketin değerlemesi üzerinde baskı oluşturması ihtimali bulunuyor. Üçüncü senaryoda soruşturmanın olumsuz sonuçlanması, yönetimde değişiklik yaşanması veya daha sıkı kısıtlamaların gündeme gelmesi halinde şirketin finansal görünümünün yeniden değerlendirilmesi gerekebileceği belirtiliyor. Zacks Baş Stratejisti John Blank ise satışların arkasında iki temel endişe bulunduğunu söyledi: ABD'nin gelişmelerin ardından yeni kısıtlamalar getirmesi ve iddialar hakkında yeni sorunların ortaya çıkması. Blank, CNBC'ye yaptığı değerlendirmede gelişmelerin Nvidia, Jensen Huang ve genel olarak yapay zekâ yatırımları açısından olumsuz olduğunu ifade etti. Morgan Stanley, Nvidia'yı en beğendiği hisseler listesinden çıkardı Morgan Stanley, çarşamba günü Nvidia'yı en beğendiği hisseler listesinden çıkardı. Bankanın bu kararı, Nvidia hisselerinin 2 Ekim'de listeye alınmasından bu yana yüzde 25'ten fazla değer kaybetmesinin ardından geldi. Analistler, Huang'ın liderliğinin Nvidia'nın stratejik yönü açısından kritik önem taşıdığını vurguladı. Şirketin üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını 17 Kasım'da açıklaması bekleniyor. Huang'ın soruşturma sürerken ofise dönerek olağan iş akışını sürdürmeye çalıştığı, salı günü de toplantılarına devam ettiği bildirildi.

news.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
news.summary: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.

news.titleTr: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
news.summaryTr: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.
news.articleText: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats - Published US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has been moved from his Washington DC home to a military base after Iran-linked threats to his life, according to US media reports. CBS, the BBC's US partner, said the relocation came after a photo of Bessent's home was published in the Wall Street Journal. Bessent has been at the forefront of efforts to isolate Iran economically through sanctions and a wider economic blockade. While the exact nature of the threats against Bessent remain unclear, US intelligence has warned that Iran has "substantially increased" efforts to target Americans, including US officials. "After the Wall Street Journal published an article featuring an online photo that allowed the location of the secretary's Georgetown home to be geo-located, security concerns began to increase," a source told CBS. Georgetown is an affluent part of Washington that is home to a number of government officials and prominent residents. Those security concerns, the source added, prompted authorities to move Bessent to a military base in the area. In a statement, a Treasury Department spokesperson said only that Bessent "will not be deterred" by threats and "remains committed" to the US effort to pressure Iran's economy. The BBC has contacted the White House for comment. In September, Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warned that Iran has "substantially increased" efforts to target Americans. The New York Times has reported that the Iranian effort includes the targeting of current and former US officials. One source told the newspaper this has "reached a more advanced stage". Other US officials reportedly on Iran's list of potential targets include former Secretary of State Mike Pompeo, former National Security Advisor John Bolton and Mark Milley, the former chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. Milley and Bolton's security teams were taken away by the Trump administration shortly after he returned to office last year. Bessent is one of a number of administration officials that live on military bases. The White House's new chief of staff, Stephen Miller, was moved to a base in late 2025 - before the conflict with Iran began. Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth and Secretary of State Marco Rubio both live on military bases, as did former Attorney General Pam Bondi and former intelligence chief Tulsi Gabbard. The US and Israel launched an air campaign against Iran in February, killing its leader and prompting the regime in Tehran to retaliate with strikes on US allies across the region and the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz, through which around a fifth of the world's oil and gas usually travels. In June, the US and Iran reached a preliminary agreement to end the war and reopen the strait, but it collapsed within weeks after Iranian attacks on shipping resumed and the US reinstated a blockade targeting Iranian ports. news.title: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
news.summary: The news comes at a turbulent time for Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying
news.summaryTr: The news comes at a turbulent time for Prabowo, who faces a growing rift with his predecessor Joko Widodo.
news.articleText: Indonesia's vice president resigns amid signs ruling alliance is fraying - Published Indonesia's Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has submitted his resignation, an aide has told the BBC, in a move which could further strain the political alliance that helped propel President Prabowo Subianto to power. It comes after Indonesia's Supreme Court ruled that a high-school document used during Gibran's 2024 election campaign was invalid. The ruling prompted more than 100 lawmakers to support a parliamentary initiative that could have paved the way for proceedings to impeach Gibran. The aide, Budi Arie, said Gibran's resignation letter was submitted directly to Prabowo on Wednesday. It remains unclear if it has been accepted. Gibran has long faced controversy over whether his high school qualifications met legal requirements to run for office. Having studied in Singapore and Australia, he had used an Indonesian equivalence certificate to demonstrate his educational credentials. Indonesian law requires vice-presidents to have completed senior secondary school or its equivalent, but the Supreme Court found no evidence to prove Gibran had graduated. "No evidence was found to show Gibran had a foreign diploma or certificate that could serve as the basis for equivalency with a senior high school or equivalent qualification," it said. It also considered a Constitutional Court ruling from earlier in October which came to the same conclusion. Gibran previously argued that undertaking university education was sufficient proof that he had completed senior high school. On Tuesday, he asked for the chance to challenge the ruling and be given the opportunity to prove the legitimacy of his education credentials, State Secretary Prasetyo Hadi said. Gibran's ascension to Prabowo's ticket in the 2024 election was part of an alliance formed between his father, outgoing president Joko Widodo - known as Jokowi - and Prabowo, his erstwhile bitter rival. Gibran was 36 at the time, and only became eligible for candidacy after a controversial ruling by the Constitutional Court, which exempted him from the minimum age requirement of 40. His resignation comes as tensions between Jokowi and Prabowo appear to have flared. Since taking the presidency, Prabowo has shown little interest in pushing ahead with Jokowi's legacy project: the construction of Nusantara, a new capital. Instead, he has focused much of the state's resources on his own flagship programme to provide free school meals across the country. In a series of personnel reshuffles over the past year, Prabowo has also shifted many Jokowi loyalists into new roles, including long-serving finance minister Sri Mulyani Indrawati. Last week, authorities arrested presidential chief of staff Listyo Sigit Prabowo - no relation - on suspicions of wiretapping the president. Prabowo sacked Listyo a day later, in what many pointed to as a sign of a crumbling alliance: Listyo, who formerly served as the national police chief, is widely considered a long-time ally of Jokowi. Within the government, allegiances seem to be shifting. On Monday, three members of Prabowo's cabinet collectively resigned from the party led by Kaesang Pangarep, Jokowi's youngest son, citing their desire to focus on their duties in Prabowo's administration. All this is unfolding at a particularly turbulent period in Prabowo's presidency. The free school meals programme is struggling for funding, parts of Indonesia have recently battled the country's worst wildfires in a decade, and the national stock market faces crisis amid allegations of widespread market manipulation. On Tuesday, students across the country staged demonstrations to protest against the government's handling of a range of issues, including the environmental crisis and corruption.

news.articleText: Türkiye’nin 82 yıllık giyim markası iflas mı etti? Şirketten iddialara yanıt geldi - Sarar Şirketler Grubu, hakkında çıkan iflas iddialarını yalanladı. Şirket, gündeme gelen hukuki uyuşmazlığın aile bireyleri arasında yaşandığını, grup şirketlerinin mali durumuyla ilgisi bulunmadığını ve faaliyetlerin kesintisiz sürdüğünü açıkladı. Türkiye'nin 82 yıllık giyim markası Sarar, hakkında çıkan iflas iddialarına ilişkin açıklama yaptı. Sarar Şirketler Grubu, gündeme gelen hukuki sürecin aile bireyleri arasındaki şahsi uyuşmazlıklardan kaynaklandığını belirterek şirketlerin herhangi bir iflas sürecinin içinde olmadığını bildirdi. İflas iddialarının ardından şirketten açıklama CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Sarar ailesinin üyeleri arasında şirket gelirlerinin paylaşımından kaynaklanan anlaşmazlık nedeniyle iflas yoluyla takip başlatıldığı yönündeki haberlerin ardından şirketten açıklama geldi. Sarar Şirketler Grubu, söz konusu sürecin grup şirketleriyle bağlantılı olmadığını vurgulayarak, haberlerde yer alan iddiaların aile bireyleri arasındaki şahsi nitelikteki uyuşmazlıklardan ibaret olduğunu belirtti. "Mali açıdan güçlü ve istikrarlı yapımızı koruyoruz" Şirket açıklamasında, aile bireyleri arasındaki hukuki anlaşmazlıkların Sarar Grup şirketlerinin mali durumuyla ilişkilendirilmemesi gerektiği ifade edildi. Açıklamada, "Sarar Grup şirketleri bahsi geçen sürecin bir parçası değildir. Haberlere konu edilen hususlar, şirketlerimizin mali durumu ile ilgisi bulunmayan, aile bireyleri arasındaki şahsi nitelikteki iddia ve uyuşmazlıklardan ibarettir" denildi. Şirketlerin mali açıdan güçlü ve istikrarlı yapısını koruduğu belirtilen açıklamada, ticari, operasyonel ve kurumsal faaliyetlerin olağan şekilde ve kesintisiz devam ettiği kaydedildi. "İflas algısı oluşturulması gerçeği yansıtmıyor" Sarar, aile içindeki hukuki uyuşmazlıkların marka ve şirketlerin mali durumuyla ilişkilendirilmesine de tepki gösterdi. Açıklamada, şirketler hakkında bir iflas süreci bulunduğu yönünde gerçeğe aykırı algı oluşturulmamasının önem taşıdığı vurgulandı.

news.articleText: Bitcoin hovers near $74K as stocks rise despite US bond yield rebound Bitcoin traded in a narrow range as investors bought the dip in tech stocks and US bond yields climbed on high CPI inflation data. Bitcoin (BTC) circled $74,000 at Wednesday’s Wall Street open as stock markets rallied and US bond yields surged. Key points: - Bitcoin failed to follow US stocks higher as CoreWeave gained up to 21% after beating Q3 revenue estimates. - The US 10-year bond yield hit a high of 5.02% on the back of higher-than-expected US CPI inflation. - BTC traded in a narrow range between its 21-week and 50-week trend lines at $73,078 and $75,492, respectively. Tech stocks rise while 10-year yield returns to 5% Data from TradingView showed BTC/USD diverging from US equities as investors resumed buying the dip in tech stocks. BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView The AI sector led the day’s early gains, with cloud-computing company CoreWeave jumping over 20% after reporting better-than-expected Q3 revenue and lifting its 2026 guidance. CoreWeave stock one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView Nvidia, which suffered on Monday and Tuesday amid ongoing controversy over CEO Jensen Huang, opened around 2.5% higher. Nvidia stock one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView Oil prices, meanwhile, gained on the day amid fading optimism over a diplomatic solution to the US-Iran war. As attacks on ships traversing the Strait of Hormuz continued, analysis pointed to several practical hurdles to restoring pre-conflict traffic levels, even if a deal is reached. “Even in the event a deal is struck, an increase in flows through the waterway would still depend on mine clearance, insurance costs and whether or not shipowners would even be willing to take the risk,” LSEG Oil Research wrote in a note on Tuesday, according to Reuters. US WTI crude oil was up 1.4% on the day at $87.70 per barrel after dropping to $84 on Tuesday, its lowest since late August. Brent crude gained 1.5% to $93.40. CFDs on WTI crude oil one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView Stocks rose even after Tuesday’s higher-than-expected Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation data pushed US bond yields sharply higher. The 10-year yield returned to 5% on Wednesday for the first time since Oct. 29, while the 30-year yield reached as high as 5.378%, a level last seen on Oct. 22. US 10-year bond yield one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView Peter Boockvar, chief investment officer at One Point BFG Wealth Partners, said that bonds were pricing in a more hawkish approach to interest rates by the US Federal Reserve. Markets have priced in a 0.25% rate hike in December, with the odds of a 0.5% move now increasing. “Inflation breakevens today are focused on the drop in oil prices while regular Treasuries today are reacting to a Fed that is definitely going to hike next month, as of now, with one another in January,” Boockvar told CNBC. Related: Here’s what happened in crypto today BTC price stays between two key trend lines Bitcoin continued to trade in a narrow range between its 21-week and 50-week simple moving average at $73,078 and $75,492, respectively. Volatility cooled as traders awaited a new catalyst after the CPI report. BTC/USD one-day chart with 21-week and 50-week SMAs. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView Investor profitability suffered as Bitcoin lost support around $75,700, the aggregate cost basis of the short-term holder (STH) cohort - entities holding a given amount of BTC without selling for up to 155 days. On Tuesday, STH wallets sent over 47,000 BTC to exchanges at an unrealized loss, potentially signaling an increase in panic selling if those coins were sold.

news.summary: Thousands are protesting across Spain over housing and the high cost of living.

news.titleTr: Protesters gather in Spain for first general strike in 14 years
news.summaryTr: Thousands are protesting across Spain over housing and the high cost of living.
news.articleText: Protesters gather in Spain for first general strike in 14 years Transport and other public services across Spain have faced serious disruption on Wednesday in the nation's first general strike in 14 years. The main unions called the strike over housing and the high cost of living, with demonstrations planned across the country. It comes nearly two weeks before Spain's parliamentary elections, which will be held on 29 November. Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez called snap elections last month after parliament failed to approve his plan for housing reform. The BBC's Nick Beake reports from the protest in Madrid.

news.titleTr: Enflasyonu doları uçurdu! Dört haftanın zirvesi görüldü: Piyasanın gözü cuma gününde
news.summaryTr: ABD'de beklentileri aşan enflasyon verisi doları dört haftanın zirvesine taşıdı. Fed'in aralık ayında faiz artırması beklenirken, cuma günü açıklanacak ÜFE verisi doların yeni yönünü belirleyebilir.
news.articleText: Enflasyonu doları uçurdu! Dört haftanın zirvesi görüldü: Piyasanın gözü cuma gününde - ABD'de beklentileri aşan enflasyon verisi doları dört haftanın zirvesine taşıdı. Fed'in aralık ayında faiz artırması beklenirken, cuma günü açıklanacak ÜFE verisi doların yeni yönünü belirleyebilir. ABD'de beklentilerin üzerinde gelen enflasyon verisi doların küresel piyasalarda son dört haftanın en yüksek seviyesine çıkmasını sağladı. Fed'in aralık ayında faiz artıracağı beklentisi güçlenirken, cuma günü açıklanacak Üretici Fiyat Endeksi (ÜFE) verisi doların yönü açısından kritik önem taşıyor. Fed'in faiz artırımı beklentisi doları destekledi CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle ABD'de salı günü açıklanan tüketici enflasyonu verilerinin beklentileri aşması, doların diğer önemli para birimleri karşısında değer kazanmasına yol açtı. Verilerin ardından Fed'in aralık ayındaki toplantısında 25 baz puanlık faiz artırımına gideceği beklentisi güçlendi. Piyasalarda daha yüksek oranlı bir faiz artışı ihtimali de yakından izleniyor. Dolarda yeni yükseliş için 50 baz puanlık artış beklentisi DHF Capital S.A. analisti Bas Kooijman, doların yükselişini sürdürebilmesi için Fed'in 50 baz puanlık faiz artırımı yapacağına yönelik beklentilerin güçlenmesi gerekebileceğini belirtti. Kooijman, aralık ayında 25 baz puanlık artışın zaten temel senaryo olduğunu, doların daha fazla değer kazanması için yarım puanlık faiz artışı ihtimalinin daha güçlü fiyatlanması gerektiğini ifade etti. Gözler cuma günü açıklanacak ÜFE verisinde Kooijman'a göre cuma günü açıklanacak ABD Üretici Fiyat Endeksi (ÜFE) verisi, doların seyrinde belirleyici olabilir. ÜFE'nin beklentilerin üzerinde gelmesi veya Fed yetkililerinden sıkı para politikasını destekleyen açıklamaların gelmesi doların yeni kazançlar elde etmesini sağlayabilir. Buna karşılık verilerin zayıf kalması durumunda doların son dönemdeki yükselişinin bir bölümünü geri vermesi beklenebilir.

news.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
news.summary: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.

news.titleTr: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
news.summaryTr: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.
news.articleText: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys. Germany’s largest lender, Deutsche Bank, launched its crypto custody service for institutional and corporate clients on Wednesday, according to an announcement shared with Cointelegraph. The bank also signed a memorandum of understanding with Deutsche Asset Management, its majority-owned asset manager, to explore collaboration on tokenized money market funds, crypto asset exchange-traded commodities and stablecoins. Deutsche Bank announced plans to offer the service to institutional and corporate clients in Europe on Sept. 16, pending regulatory clearance. Deutsche Bank’s listing for crypto custody and transfer services in the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) register is dated Oct. 12 and names Germany’s BaFin as its regulator. The service initially supports Bitcoin (BTC), Ether (ETH) and select stablecoins, including Circle’s USDC (USDC) and EURC (EURC), as well as AllUnity EURAU. Gerald Podobnik, co-head of Deutsche Bank’s corporate bank, told Reuters in October that the bank planned to launch in Germany before expanding to Asian financial centers in 2027. Deutsche Bank partnered with crypto infrastructure provider Taurus in 2023 to develop custody services after applying for a digital asset custody license in Germany. Related: Deutsche Bank-backed AllUnity launches Swiss franc stablecoin CHFAU

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
news.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, Barclays’ BlackRock Bitcoin ETF holdings rose 48% in the third quarter, pro-crypto lawmaker Tom Emmer was elected House Republican minority whip as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress and hotter-than-expected US inflation raised concerns about a potential half-point Federal Reserve rate hike in December. Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings Barclays reported holding 3.94 million shares in BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF) at the end of the third quarter, up 48% from the previous quarter. The position in the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT) was worth about $187 million on Sept. 30, up from $88.5 million for 2.66 million shares on June 30, according to Barclays’ Friday Form 13F filing. “Early readings suggest longer-term holders make up a growing share of the spot bitcoin ETF investor base,” Bitwise analyst Camran Khosravi told Cointelegraph, pointing to increased bank exposure, including at Citigroup. Citigroup reported a new position worth about $119 million in the Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC). Its reported IBIT holdings also rose 50% to about 521,000 shares, from 347,000 at the end of June. The filings offer an early indication of changing institutional Bitcoin ETF ownership, with more major banks and hedge funds yet to disclose their third-quarter positions. Institutional investment managers have until Monday to file their third-quarter holdings reports. Crypto ally Tom Emmer elected House GOP minority whip Pro-crypto US Representative Tom Emmer has been elected House Republican minority whip, securing the party’s second-highest leadership position as Democrats prepare to take control of Congress in January. Emmer beat Texas Representative August Pfluger in a 103-76 secret ballot vote, according to Politico. He previously served as House Republican majority whip and will remain the party’s No. 2 leader, this time under incoming Minority Leader Jim Jordan. As minority whip, Emmer will be responsible for rallying Republican votes, coordinating the party’s legislative strategy and helping maintain unity on key bills. “Tom has been one of the strongest advocates for digital assets in Congress, and he has led the fight against a government-controlled CBDC and stood up for American innovators,” GOP Senator Cynthia Lummis said on X. Hot US inflation raises odds of half-point Fed hike in December Crypto industry experts warned on Tuesday that higher-than-expected US inflation could lead to a another Federal Reserve interest rate hike, making borrowing more expensive and potentially discouraging investment in cryptocurrencies. The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.4% month over month in October, above economists’ forecast of 0.3%, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics - a slower increase than September’s 0.6% rise. Core inflation, which excludes food and energy prices, rose 0.3%, above the expected 0.2%. Currently, the Federal Reserve holds its benchmark interest rate at 3.75% to 4.00%, after raising it by a quarter-point in September and leaving it unchanged in October. The report came just a few hours after Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said in London that another core inflation reading of 0.3% or higher could prompt the Fed to consider a larger interest rate hike in December. “In that case, I believe a 50-basis-point hike in the policy rate should be considered at the December meeting,” Waller said. “Hiking only 25-basis-points would put our credibility at risk, a risk I am not eager to take.”

news.titleTr: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
news.summaryTr: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.
news.articleText: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline. The collapse of Paraguay’s digital lender Ueno Bank last week left nearly three million customers — roughly 60% of Paraguay’s adults — unable to access their accounts. Paraguay’s Central Bank placed Ueno into resolution on Nov. 3 after its solvency ratio fell below half the legally required minimum. An investigation uncovered questionable lending practices and deficiencies in credit documentation and accounting. The collapse also triggered a political crisis, with thousands taking to the streets to protest and President Santiago Peña attempting to resign before being impeached and arrested on charges of breach of trust and using his office for personal gain. Paraguay’s peer-to-peer crypto market immediately reflected the turmoil, with some sellers asking for a USDt premium of up to 13%. “USDt is a lifeline for hundreds millions of people in the world,” Tether chief executive Paolo Ardoino said. For many, the incident sparked uncertainty over savings, wages and the money needed to cover everyday expenses. With the local guaraní (PYG) currency falling 12.3% in a week, some turned to stablecoins to maintain the value of their funds, or just to keep payments moving along. David Eisenmann, founder and chief executive of Paraguayan crypto exchange X4T, tells Magazine the timing made the liquidity need even more pronounced. “The intervention came in the first days of the month,” he says, “exactly when salaries, rent and supplier invoices are due,” adding that many business owners “couldn’t make payroll.” For some, USDt was “suddenly the most liquid money” they had: “This week they learned that having an account isn’t the same as having access to your money.” But beyond another TradFi masterclass in the virtues of self-custody, Ueno’s collapse highlights the growing role of dollar-pegged stablecoins providing an alternative source of liquidity when traditional banks fail. Crypto as a source of liquidity Eisenmann says X4T processed more than $10 million in local on-ramp volume over the 30 days to early November, but some of that activity predated Ueno’s collapse. “The dollar began recovering against the guaraní in October,” he says, “and the Ueno news sped up a move that was already underway.” Related: Stablecoins can drain from banks and nations at lightning speed He says the activity “runs in both directions,” with some customers selling crypto for guaraníes or dollars to cover payments they could no longer make through Ueno, while “demand for USDt and USDC as a dollar store of value has risen sharply.” Paraguay’s Central Bank placed Ueno into resolution on Nov. 3. Source: Central Bank of Paraguay As of Nov. 9 the Central Bank said 93.1% of customers with Ueno deposits had been repaid. Despite this confidence has been shaken and X4T continued to see higher online inquiries for dollar-denominated stablecoins. In fact, Eisenmann says the level “has not changed significantly” from the week of the collapse. Rhys Hicks, associate analyst at data and analytics company GlobalData, says the digital bank’s failure has shown “how much can go wrong when governance does not keep pace with growth.” That said, he’s not seeing evidence of a mass migration from Paraguayan banks into stablecoins, since other banks “picked up the slack,” and people “seem to have been angrier” with the government than with the banks. “Some consumers will look for different ways to keep their money safe, but I do not see an overwhelming shift to stablecoins yet,” he says. An old impulse, with new rails Seeking dollars when confidence in domestic banks falters is hardly new. In Argentina’s 2001 financial crisis, the government imposed the “corralito,” restricting cash withdrawals from bank accounts, following a run on deposits. Related: Peter Thiel backs crypto-friendly Silicon Valley Bank rival — Report Amid a deepening crisis over the country’s currency peg and sovereign debt, the government later converted dollar-denominated deposits into pesos, reducing people’s savings by about 30% overnight and further damaging confidence in the country’s fraying banking system. Tether CEO calls USDt a lifeline. Source: Paolo Ardoino But stablecoins aren’t decentralized and they are not insulated from the banking system either. During the March 2023 collapse of Silicon Valley Bank, stablecoin issuer Circle disclosed that $3.3 billion of USDC reserves, around 8% of the total, were held at the lender. USDC briefly depegged and fell to 86 cents on secondary markets after Circle said it could not withdraw the funds. A BIS paper on stablecoins and the international monetary system warns that widespread use of dollar-backed tokens could create challenges for monetary sovereignty in emerging markets. Hicks says stablecoins can provide an alternative during periods of political instability and “low trust in the local system” because they are pegged to a more stable currency, like the US dollar. But regulators need to address “transparency” and “consumer protection,” he says, because stablecoin holders don’t benefit from the same deposit guarantees as bank customers, and there is no central bank to step in and make them whole. Eisenmann says he expects the incident to spark more “diversification,” with people “spreading their money across banks, cash and digital assets” instead of relying on a single institution. “How quickly trust in the banks returns will depend on how quickly and transparently the authorities handle the resolution,” he says. news.titleTr: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions
news.summaryTr: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.
news.articleText: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs. This is Part 5 in the technical article series about Bitcoin covenants by Cointelegraph Research. To read the previous article click here. MATT (Merkleize All The Things) is a smart contract framework for Bitcoin that enables stateful contracts and scalable fraud proofs. A stateful contract carries information forward across multiple transactions and can update this information as the contract evolves. Standard Bitcoin scripts do not provide this capability, because each transaction is evaluated independently with no memory of previous executions. Every covenant proposal allows state-carrying UTXOs to an extent, as illustrated by scripting languages such as Sapio, which builds on OP_CTV. This works by using addresses to represent a finite state automaton, where transactions function as the state transitions. However, there is no way to elegantly implement numerical logic in this paradigm, a gap filled by MATT, and in particular its proposed implementation through OP_CCV. Because MATT allows committed data to be computed at spend time and re-embedded into the next output, each spend can derive a new state dynamically, instead of choosing from a predetermined set of states. How OP_CCV commits state into a Taproot key To understand the MATT proposal, it is useful to first review how Taproot commits data through public keys. Every Taproot output contains a base public key, called the internal key, which can be cryptographically modified or “tweaked” to commit to extra information. Formally, the tweaked public key is Q = P + t·G, where P is the internal key, G is the generator of the secp256k1 elliptic curve, and t is a tagged hash of P and the committed data. In a regular Taproot output, this commitment typically encodes the Merkle root of a taptree, which contains hidden spending paths. MATT builds on this mechanism to also embed contract state into the key. Instead of embedding complex logic directly in Bitcoin’s scripting language, MATT encodes computation as a sequence of state commitments, and the chain verifies only that each state transition is valid. MATT can be realized through different opcode combinations. The most direct and well-specified implementation relies on OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY (OP_CCV). OP_CCV provides the primitive that makes state-carrying UTXOs feasible within Taproot. OP_CCV allows a script to verify that a Taproot input or output key has been tweaked to commit to a specific piece of state data. The internal key is first tweaked with a hash of the contract’s current state, and then Taproot’s standard taptree tweak is applied on top. The resulting output key therefore commits to both the tapscript (the set of spending conditions) and the current state of the contract. OP_CCV can then enforce what state is carried forward into the next output. It allows the script to inspect the state data provided on the witness stack, perform computations on it, and require that the resulting updated state is correctly re-committed in a specified output. This is how state transitions are enforced on-chain. The stack format is: OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY The opcode supports three modes for checking an output as well as a separate input mode. In default mode, the entire BTC value of the input UTXO is allocated to the specified output; in deduct mode, only a portion equal to the output’s amount is assigned, leaving the remainder available for further outputs; and in ignore mode, the script and data commitment are verified without constraining the amount. Because default and deduct modes are designed to preserve value across checked outputs, transaction fees must be paid through separate fee-paying inputs. A dedicated fee input and change output can be added to the transaction without conflicting with the covenant’s constraints. This prevents the accidental burning of funds that can occur in more primitive covenant implementations, such as OP_CTV or SIGHASH_ANYPREVOUT. It also addresses a major limitation of presigned-transaction-style covenants, which typically define amounts upfront and therefore cannot accommodate dynamic fee adjustments or partial unvaults. OP_CCV + OP_CAT: Merkle Proofs and Fraud Proofs When OP_CCV is combined with OP_CAT, the full MATT framework becomes even more expressive. OP_CAT enables byte concatenation in Script, which makes it possible to construct and verify Merkle proofs directly on-chain. Two distinct Merkle trees are associated with a Taproot output in such an arrangement. The first is the familiar Taproot script tree (the taptree), whose leaves are the contract’s spending scripts. The second is a separate state tree, whose leaves are the contract’s data, such as the intermediate steps of a computation. The OP_CCV + OP_CAT script can verify a Merkle proof against the current state tree root, compute the updated root after a transition, and use OP_CCV to force the next output to commit to it. This construction enables fraud-proof systems with a slashing condition in which a long computation is committed off-chain, and only the specific disputed step (with its path in the binary tree) needs to be revealed and verified on-chain. Similar systems exist as optimistic rollups on other blockchain systems: the full computation runs off-chain, and the on-chain contract only intervenes when someone raises a challenge. Fraud proofs require that the computation be compiled down to a binary circuit or equivalent step-by-step representation that can be committed to in a Merkle tree. OP_CCV + OP_CAT would avoid the need for the Lamport one-time signatures and pre-signed transaction graphs that BitVM relies on to enforce state consistency. Beyond fraud proofs, the OP_CCV and OP_CAT combination also has implications for vaults. OP_CCV alone can implement vaults, but when combined with OP_CAT, it allows fully featured vaults that are essentially equivalent to the functionality proposed by OP_VAULT. As James O’Beirne, the author of OP_VAULT, has noted, OP_CCV represents a more general and robust design that effectively supersedes his earlier proposal. In the next article in this series, we will move on from general covenant proposals to review application-specific opcodes such as OP_VAULT, OP_UNVAULT, and OP_EVICT. Each of the opcodes are designed to solve a specific problem rather than provide broad programmability. Magazine: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?

news.title: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
news.summary: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.

news.titleTr: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
news.summaryTr: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.
news.articleText: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion. CoreWeave shares jumped 15.27% in premarket trading Wednesday after the AI cloud provider reported third-quarter revenue that beat analyst estimates. The shares traded at $56.12 as of 12:50 pm UTC, trimming the stock’s year-to-date decline to 32%, according to Yahoo Finance. CoreWeave reported $3.66 billion in third-quarter revenue after the market closed on Tuesday, up 168% from $1.36 billion a year earlier. Revenue came in about 3.4% above the $3.54 billion consensus estimate compiled by Google Finance. The company also reported a revenue backlog of about $132.5 billion as of Sept. 30. The figure includes revenue CoreWeave expects to recognize under existing customer contracts, subject to delivery and service availability. In April, CoreWeave announced a multiyear agreement with AI developer Anthropic to provide computing capacity for its Claude models. Days later, CoreWeave signed a $6 billion deal with quantitative trading company Jane Street to supply cloud infrastructure for trading and research. CoreWeave started as a crypto miner and began shifting to AI infrastructure in 2019. Related: CoreWeave shows how crypto-era infrastructure quietly became AI’s backbone

news.title: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
news.summary: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
news.summaryTr: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.
news.articleText: FSB urgest Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators. The Financial Stability Board (FSB) urged Turkey to tighten its oversight of crypto markets and adopt dedicated rules for stablecoins. In a peer review published on Wednesday, the global financial watchdog said Turkish authorities had made progress by introducing registration and licensing requirements for crypto service providers. The report was part of the FSB’s regular program of country reviews and assessed Turkey’s progress in implementing the board’s 2023 global recommendations on crypto and stablecoins. It followed a broader 2025 review that found gaps in how jurisdictions had implemented those recommendations. The FSB recommended that Turkey begin monitoring crypto-related risks to financial stability under a formal framework, strengthen supervision and enforcement, and improve cooperation and information sharing with foreign regulators. Turkey’s Capital Markets Board introduced licensing and operational requirements for crypto exchanges and custodians in March 2025, including minimum capital thresholds. The FSB said Turkey had introduced safeguards including requirements to segregate assets held in custody and a ban on domestic crypto payments. The safeguards help limit the spread of crypto-related risks to banks and payment systems. Authorities also launched a centralized platform to monitor crypto activities. The FSB’s 2025 review found that Turkey had finalized rules for crypto assets but lacked a dedicated stablecoin framework. In June 2025, Turkey’s Finance Ministry outlined plans to introduce additional transaction checks and limits on stablecoin transfers to combat money laundering. Related: Turkey tightens crypto rules with source, purpose checks on transfers

news.summaryTr: Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives.
news.articleText: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives. Zcash (ZEC) fell to a two-month low of $962.85 on Wednesday, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to nonprofits and projects supporting the Zcash network. As of 12:20 pm UTC Wednesday, Zcash’s 13.5% drop led 24-hour losses among the 100 largest cryptocurrencies by market capitalization and was down 24.5% over seven days. The decline was part of a broader crypto sell-off that left Bitcoin (BTC) down 5.8% and Ether (ETH) down 11.6% over the same period, according to CoinGecko. Crypto prices fell further Tuesday after US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October from the previous month, above economists’ 0.3% forecast. Zcash lets users send shielded payments that keep sender and recipient addresses and transaction amounts out of public view. Zcash helped drive this year’s rally in privacy coins, gaining 138% in the 30 days to Sept. 7. It remains the largest privacy coin by market value, accounting for about 60% of the $28 billion category tracked by CoinGecko. The category’s combined market value fell about 7% over 24 hours. ZEC traded above $1,370 as recently as Friday, when Zcash activated its NU7 upgrade. The upgrade cut the target time between blocks from 75 seconds to 25 to speed up transaction confirmations. It also made about 12,224 ZEC held in the network’s original privacy pool unspendable. Grayscale converted its Zcash Trust into a US spot exchange-traded fund (ETF) that began trading on NYSE Arca on Aug. 25. The fund recorded about $15 million in net outflows in November through Monday, following about $46 million in October, according to SoSoValue. Related: Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade

news.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

news.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

items.articleText: Apple hisselerinde rekor rallisi! Yükseliş yüzde 30'a ulaşırken piyasalar hareketlendi - Apple hisseleri, 2026 başından bu yana yüzde 30 yükselerek tüm zamanların rekorunu kırdı. Çarşamba günü yaklaşık 900 bin opsiyon işlemi gerçekleşirken alım opsiyonlarının hacmi satım opsiyonlarını geride bıraktı. Apple hisseleri, teknoloji piyasasındaki sert satışlara ve faiz artışı endişelerine rağmen yükselişini sürdürerek tüm zamanların en yüksek seviyesine ulaştı. 2026 başından bu yana yüzde 30 değer kazanan hissede, opsiyon işlemlerinde de alım yönlü hareketlilik dikkat çekti. Apple hisselerinde rekor yükseliş CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle CNBC sunucusu Jim Cramer'ın sıkça dile getirdiği "Apple'a yatırım yaparsınız, al-sat yapmazsınız" yaklaşımı, şirket hisselerinin son performansıyla yeniden gündeme geldi. Apple hisseleri çarşamba günü yüzde 1,79 yükselerek 354,75 dolara ulaştı. Şirketin hisseleri, kısa süreli bilanço kaynaklı düşüşe rağmen geçen hafta Covid-19'dan bu yana teknoloji hisselerinde görülen en sert satış dalgasını, yarı iletken sektöründeki ayı piyasasını ve faiz artışı endişelerini geride bıraktı. Böylece Apple'ın 2026 yılındaki toplam yükselişi yüzde 30'a ulaştı ve hisse yeni bir rekor seviyeye çıktı. Opsiyon piyasasında alım yönlü hareketlilik Apple hisselerindeki dirençli görünüm, teknoloji sektöründe güvenli liman arayan opsiyon yatırımcılarının da dikkatini çekti. Çarşamba günü seansın ilk yarısında Apple hisseleri üzerinde yaklaşık 900 bin opsiyon işlemi gerçekleştirildi. Bunların yaklaşık 500 bini alım (call), 370 bini ise satım (put) opsiyonlarından oluştu. Yatırımcılar ayın başında şirketin bilançosu öncesinde satım opsiyonlarına yönelmişti. Ancak hisselerin yeniden yükselişe geçmesiyle put/call açık pozisyon oranı 0,95'ten 0,87'ye geriledi. Günlük işlem hacminde ise alım opsiyonları öne çıktı. Bu tablo, Apple hisselerindeki yükselişin opsiyon piyasasında da alım yönlü beklentileri güçlendirdiğine işaret ediyor.

items.summary: AB'nin Çin'den ithalata yönelik kuralları sıkılaştırma ve yerel üretimi destekleme adımları Arçelik'e avantaj sağlayabilir. Bloomberg'e göre şirket, Avrupa'daki fabrikaları sayesinde Çinli rakiplerine karşı daha güçlü konumda olmayı hedefliyor.

items.titleTr: ABD medyası yazdı: Avrupa'nın yeni kuralları Türk beyaz eşya devine yarayabilir
items.summaryTr: AB'nin Çin'den ithalata yönelik kuralları sıkılaştırma ve yerel üretimi destekleme adımları Arçelik'e avantaj sağlayabilir. Bloomberg'e göre şirket, Avrupa'daki fabrikaları sayesinde Çinli rakiplerine karşı daha güçlü konumda olmayı hedefliyor.
items.articleText: ABD medyası yazdı: Avrupa'nın yeni kuralları Türk beyaz eşya devine yarayabilir - AB'nin Çin'den ithalata yönelik kuralları sıkılaştırma ve yerel üretimi destekleme adımları Arçelik'e avantaj sağlayabilir. Bloomberg'e göre şirket, Avrupa'daki fabrikaları sayesinde Çinli rakiplerine karşı daha güçlü konumda olmayı hedefliyor. Avrupa Birliği'nin ithalatı sıkılaştırma ve yerel üretimi destekleme adımları, Türk ihracatçılar arasında endişe yaratırken Arçelik için fırsata dönüşebilir. Bloomberg'in haberine göre şirket, Avrupa'daki mevcut fabrikaları sayesinde Çinli rakiplerine karşı avantaj elde edebileceğini düşünüyor. Avrupa'daki fabrikalar Arçelik'in elini güçlendiriyor CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Arçelik'in küresel markası Beko'nun Finans Direktörü Barış Alparslan, Türkiye'deki rekabetçi üretim yapısı ve Avrupa'daki fabrikaların şirkete önemli avantaj sağladığını belirtti. Beko'nun Avrupa'da halihazırda üretim tesislerine sahip olması, şirketin yerel üretimi desteklemeyi amaçlayan yeni AB düzenlemelerine Çinli rakiplerinden daha kolay uyum sağlamasına imkan tanıyabilir. Alparslan, Beko'nun Avrupa'daki güçlü marka bilinirliğinin de rekabette önemli rol oynadığını ifade etti. Bu konumun şirketin fiyatlarını ve satış sonrası hizmetlerini koruyarak Çinli üreticilerle rekabet etmesine yardımcı olabileceği değerlendiriliyor. AB'nin yeni düzenlemeleri Türk ihracatçıları endişelendiriyor Avrupa Birliği, Çin'den yapılan ithalata bağımlılığı azaltmak ve Avrupa'daki üretimi güçlendirmek amacıyla yeni düzenlemeler üzerinde çalışıyor. Bu kapsamda, belirli ithal ürünlerin üretiminden kaynaklanan karbon emisyonlarını fiyatlandıran Sınırda Karbon Düzenleme Mekanizması (SKDM) ve Avrupa'da üretilen ürünleri desteklemeyi hedefleyen "Made in Europe" girişimi öne çıkıyor. Avrupa, Türkiye'nin en önemli ihracat pazarlarından biri olduğu için söz konusu düzenlemeler Türk üreticiler açısından pazara erişim ve rekabet koşullarına ilişkin soru işaretleri yaratıyor. Arçelik ise Avrupa'daki mevcut üretim tesisleri sayesinde yeni dönemde Çinli rakiplerinden ayrışabileceğini düşünüyor. Arçelik'in üçüncü çeyrek zararı iki katı aştı Şirket, Avrupa pazarındaki rekabetin yanı sıra Türkiye'deki yüksek faiz oranları ve zayıf tüketici talebinin baskısıyla karşı karşıya. Arçelik, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 6,21 milyar TL net zarar açıkladı. Şirketin net zararı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 2,67 milyar TL'ye kıyasla iki katından fazla arttı. Arçelik'in Beko dışında Whirlpool ve Grundig markaları da bulunuyor.

items.title: Poundland set for more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
items.summary: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Poundland set for more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue
items.summaryTr: The BBC understands the discount chain, which has been edging towards administration, will be given more time to find a buyer.
items.articleText: Poundland set for more time to secure a rescue deal as emergency talks continue - Published Poundland and its 11,000 employees are hopeful that the retailer's impending collapse can be delayed to allow time for a last-minute rescue deal. The discount chain has been edging towards administration after being blocked by its owners from accessing cash in its bank accounts. A deadline to secure a buyer for the business is set to expire at midnight, but sources close to the situation have told the BBC that they expect more time will be given, thanks to the release of £10m in funding. A committee of MPs questioned Gordon Brothers, Poundland's US owners, on Wednesday following accusations that the investment firm hopes to profit from selling off Poundland's 600 stores and stock piecemeal. Gordon Brothers - which bought the chain for just £1 last year - is accused of forcing that outcome by restricting Poundland's access to available cash needed to restock stores and pay wages and rent, ahead of the crucial Christmas trading period. The investment firm has denied the claims. But pressure remains on Poundland's owners after a takeover bid was rejected. The decision prompted calls for answers from politicians, including Prime Minister Andy Burnham. About £50m had been frozen by Gordon Brothers, the BBC understands, meaning Poundland bosses were unable to restock shelves across its 600 shops. However, sources close to the matter told the BBC on Tuesday that a release of £10m by its owners, while "small in the scale of things" could help at least postpone the chain's collapse while a longer term solution was explored. 'Do the right thing' Following the behind-closed-doors meeting between MPs on the business and trade committee and representatives of Gordon Brothers, chair Liam Byrne said he was "deeply concerned" that firm's behaviour "may have jeopardised thousands of jobs on Britain's high streets". "Over the last 17 months, they have taken millions out of Poundland when the business was on a 'knife edge'," he posted on social media., external "Now Poundland appears to be on the rebound, there's concerning signs it's been strangled of access to its own funds in what should be its busiest trading period in the run up to Christmas." He claimed that Gordon Brothers refused to say it would prioritise saving jobs "over and above its own financial returns", but added the prospect of a good outcome for the business was "now higher thanks to the focus on the business of the last week". He called on Gordon Brothers "to do the right thing" and give Poundland access to its own funds and work to protect the maximum number of jobs. Views on Poundland performance differ The 10-day moratorium to protect Poundland from its creditors expires on Thursday, but if there is a prospect of a solvent deal, the deadline could be extended. Views on the chain's performance differ between those running operations and the owners. Poundland boss Barry Williams told staff last week that like-for-like sales, which exclude new store openings, were up 11.4%. The sales period included Halloween, but Williams said this was £1.5m ahead of budget. He added the business made a profit of £18.1m in the year to September, which was a "strong recovery" from the previous year where there were losses of £68m. However, Gordon Brothers has painted a different picture, saying the chain remains "challenged and vulnerable to any potential downturn in future trading". There has been interest from the likes of Poundstretcher, Tesco and B&M in picking up Poundland stores which could mean continuing employment for workers in the event the chain is broken up and sold off in chunks. The main issue is whether a piecemeal sale would protect more jobs than a buyer willing to keep Poundland as a national chain. Get in touch Are you affected by issues discussed in this story? items.title: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
items.summary: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public. It is not known if the incidents are linked.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax
items.summaryTr: More than 6,000 Italian schools received a threat. Authorities in all three countries say there appears to be no risk to the public. It is not known if the incidents are linked.
items.articleText: Schools in Italy, Scotland and Northern Ireland hit by threats in suspected bomb hoax - Published Some 6,300 schools across Italy and more than 700 in Scotland and Northern Ireland have received bomb threats, according to local authorities. In Italy a number of buildings were evacuated as a precaution but Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni said checks so far had not indicated any evidence of "concrete danger". "These reports appear rather linked to a strategy intended to cause alarm and concern," she said on Facebook. Scotland's education secretary Mairi McAllan said there was no risk to the public and specialist cyber-crime officers were working to identify the source of the messages. In Northern Ireland education officials told schools to remain open unless otherwise advised by police. It is unclear whether the incidents are connected. "As a parent and as a constituency MSP I understand just how concerning this will be for parents, for pupils, for carers and for school staff," McAllan said. Scottish police had earlier said that the warnings were "immediately assessed" as hoaxes. However some local authorities confirmed that some schools had been evacuated. "Our advice is that there is no requirement to evacuate schools or keep children away from education based solely on the content of the emails," Police Scotland said. Italian officials said a single email appeared to have been sent on Wednesday to the inboxes of 6,300 out of a total of 7,476 state schools, and private schools were unaffected. The message, said to be from a certain "Mikhail Andropov, leader of Vilayat di Misoginistan", caused alarm in many schools. The BBC has seen the email sent to Scottish schools which appeared to have similar wording, and also referenced the name Mikhail Andropov, although as leader of a "Red Owl" project. Italy's Education Minister Giuseppe Valditara said the incidents involving Italian schools were probably a "cyber-attack, not a genuine risk", adding that there appeared to be a clear strategy behind the rash of threats in across Europe targeting flights, supermarkets and even hospitals. Italian airports along with airlines elsewhere in Europe were hit by a series of bomb hoaxes last week that prompted a series of scares, evacuations and widespread disruption. Although a number of threats were claimed by an extremist misogynistic group, it later denied any link to the false warnings. - No risk to public from hoax school bomb threats, says government minister - Published45 minutes ago - Police treating threatening email sent to more than 300 schools as 'hoax' - Published3 hours ago On Wednesday one Milan headteacher, Anna Bertato, told Italian media she had checked the email address of the sender online: "It was already classified as spam by a student at a university in Taiwan." Another Milan headteacher, Massimo Nunzio Barrella, told Adnkronos news agency that he had immediately realised the email was spam when it arrived in his inbox at 08:59 and he decided not to evacuate his school and reassured parents who phoned in. "The text seemed almost comical," said Barrella, "it was like a message from Martians: 'We have come to annihilate you.' I even had a bit of a laugh." Although many schools were initially evacuated on Wednesday, the alarm was quickly lifted, and pupils were allowed to return to class. Some parents decided to take their children home for the day, but the majority of schools in Milan did not send their pupils home. Some 280 school head teachers had already received threats in recent days, according to Italian reports. In a statement, the head of the central Umbria region Stefania Proietti said "checks conducted so far in Umbrian schools have proved negative, and law enforcement is working rapidly and carefully to verify each report". Related topics - Published5 days ago
